scripts.source:
--!strict
-- P pauses the run, but only when one player is on the server. The paused
-- state is a workspace attribute so the client can show the overlay.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Net = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Net)
local RunState = require(script.Parent.RunState)

local PauseService = {}

local pausedAt = 0

function PauseService.set(paused: boolean)
	if paused == RunState.paused then
		return
	end
	RunState.paused = paused
	workspace:SetAttribute("Paused", paused)
	if paused then
		pausedAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
		RunState.PausedChanged:Fire(true, 0)
	else
		RunState.PausedChanged:Fire(false, workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - pausedAt)
	end
end

function PauseService.start()
	workspace:SetAttribute("Paused", false)
	Net.event("PauseRequest").OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player)
		local allowed = RunState.active
			and RunState.phase ~= "Over"
			and RunState.isParticipant(player)
			and #Players:GetPlayers() == 1
		if allowed or RunState.paused then
			PauseService.set(not RunState.paused)
		end
	end)
	-- Someone joining always unpauses.
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function()
		PauseService.set(false)
	end)
end

return PauseService

scripts.name: Placeables
scripts.source:
--!strict
-- Things players drop on the cell in front of them: barrels (block enemies,
-- explode when shot or caught in a blast, chaining into other barrels), fake
-- walls (only block), mines (explode when an enemy steps on them) and
-- machine-gun turrets (shoot the nearest enemy until out of ammo).
-- Blocking placeables are obstacles for enemy pathing; enemies that can't get
-- around them attack them.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Hitscan = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Hitscan)
local Net = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Net)
local PropModels = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Models.PropModels)
local RoomGrid = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.RoomGrid)
local WeaponStats = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.WeaponStats)
local Arena = require(script.Parent.Arena)
local EnemyService = require(script.Parent.EnemyService)
local KillContext = require(script.Parent.KillContext)
local RunState = require(script.Parent.RunState)
local Scoring = require(script.Parent.Scoring)

local ShotFired = Net.event("ShotFired")
local ExplosionRemote = Net.event("Explosion")

export type Placeable = {
	id: number,
	kind: string, -- barrel, wall, mine, turret
	owner: Player?,
	c: number,
	r: number,
	x: number,
	z: number,
	health: number,
	alive: boolean,
	detonating: boolean,
	model: Model,
	head: Model?,
	blastRadius: number,
	blastDamage: number,
	ammo: number,
	fireInterval: number,
	fireReadyAt: number,
}

local Placeables = {}

-- Set by Explosions at startup: makes a barrel or mine go off.
Placeables.onExplode = function(_placeable: Placeable, _by: Player?) end

local BLOCKS_ENEMIES: { [string]: boolean } = { barrel = true, wall = true, turret = true }
local HEALTH: { [string]: number } = {
	barrel = Config.BARREL_HEALTH,
	wall = Config.WALL_HEALTH,
	mine = 1,
	turret = Config.TURRET_HEALTH,
}

local grid: RoomGrid.RoomGrid? = nil
local all: { Placeable } = {}
local byCell: { [number]: Placeable } = {}
local lastId = 0

local function key(c: number, r: number): number
	return r * 10000 + c
end

function Placeables.start(g: RoomGrid.RoomGrid)
	Placeables.clear()
	grid = g
	EnemyService.hooks.blockingPlaceableAt = function(c: number, r: number): any
		local placeable = byCell[key(c, r)]
		if placeable and BLOCKS_ENEMIES[placeable.kind] then
			return placeable
		end
		return nil
	end
	EnemyService.hooks.attackPlaceable = function(placeable: any, damage: number)
		Placeables.damage(placeable :: Placeable, damage, nil)
	end
end

function Placeables.clear()
	for _, placeable in all do
		placeable.alive = false
		placeable.model:Destroy()
	end
	table.clear(all)
	table.clear(byCell)
end

function Placeables.list(): { Placeable }
	return all
end

-- Living barrels, for bullets to hit.
function Placeables.barrels(): { Placeable }
	local list = {}
	for _, placeable in all do
		if placeable.kind == "barrel" and placeable.alive and not placeable.detonating then
			table.insert(list, placeable)
		end
	end
	return list
end

function Placeables.canPlace(c: number, r: number): boolean
	local g = grid
	if not g or not g:inBounds(c, r) then
		return false
	end
	local char = g:cell(c, r)
	if char == "#" or char == "S" or g:isBlocked(c, r) or byCell[key(c, r)] then
		return false
	end
	-- Not on top of a player.
	for _, participant in RunState.alive() do
		local character = participant.player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
			local pc, pr = g:worldToCell(root.Position.X, root.Position.Z)
			if pc == c and pr == r then
				return false
			end
		end
	end
	return true
end

function Placeables.place(owner: Player, kind: string, c: number, r: number, stats: WeaponStats.Stats): boolean
	local g = grid
	if not g or not Placeables.canPlace(c, r) then
		return false
	end
	local x, z = g:cellCenter(c, r)
	local at = CFrame.new(x, 0, z)
	local model: Model
	local head: Model? = nil
	if kind == "barrel" then
		model = PropModels.barrel(at)
	elseif kind == "wall" then
		model = PropModels.wall(at)
	elseif kind == "mine" then
		model = PropModels.mine(at)
	elseif kind == "turret" then
		model, head = PropModels.turret(at)
	else
		return false
	end
	lastId += 1
	model:SetAttribute("Kind", kind)
	model:SetAttribute("CellC", c)
	model:SetAttribute("CellR", r)
	model.Parent = Arena.props()

	local placeable: Placeable = {
		id = lastId,
		kind = kind,
		owner = owner,
		c = c,
		r = r,
		x = x,
		z = z,
		health = HEALTH[kind] or 50,
		alive = true,
		detonating = false,
		model = model,
		head = head,
		blastRadius = stats.blastRadius,
		blastDamage = stats.damage,
		ammo = Config.TURRET_AMMO,
		fireInterval = stats.turretFireInterval,
		fireReadyAt = 0,
	}
	table.insert(all, placeable)
	byCell[key(c, r)] = placeable
	if kind == "wall" then
		g:setBlocked(c, r, true) -- fake walls stop bullets too
	end
	EnemyService.markDirty()
	return true
end

function Placeables.remove(placeable: Placeable)
	if not placeable.alive then
		return
	end
	placeable.alive = false
	local index = table.find(all, placeable)
	if index then
		table.remove(all, index)
	end
	if byCell[key(placeable.c, placeable.r)] == placeable then
		byCell[key(placeable.c, placeable.r)] = nil
	end
	local g = grid
	if placeable.kind == "wall" and g then
		g:setBlocked(placeable.c, placeable.r, false)
	end
	placeable.model:Destroy()
	EnemyService.markDirty()
end

-- Barrels and mines go off after `delay` seconds; `by` gets the credit
-- (defaults to whoever placed it).
function Placeables.detonate(placeable: Placeable, delay: number, by: Player?)
	if placeable.detonating or not placeable.alive then
		return
	end
	placeable.detonating = true
	task.delay(delay, function()
		if not placeable.alive then
			return
		end
		Placeables.remove(placeable)
		Placeables.onExplode(placeable, by)
	end)
end

function Placeables.damage(placeable: Placeable, amount: number, by: Player?)
	if not placeable.alive or placeable.detonating then
		return
	end
	placeable.health -= amount
	if placeable.health > 0 then
		return
	end
	if placeable.kind == "barrel" or placeable.kind == "mine" then
		Placeables.detonate(placeable, 0, by)
	else
		Placeables.remove(placeable)
		ExplosionRemote:FireAllClients(placeable.x, placeable.z, 0, "break")
	end
end

local function enemyCircle(enemy: EnemyService.Enemy): (number, number, number)
	return enemy.x, enemy.z, enemy.radius
end

local function updateTurret(g: RoomGrid.RoomGrid, turret: Placeable, clock: number)
	if clock < turret.fireReadyAt then
		return
	end
	-- Nearest enemy in range with a clear line of fire.
	local target: EnemyService.Enemy? = nil
	local bestSq = Config.TURRET_RANGE * Config.TURRET_RANGE
	for _, enemy in EnemyService.list() do
		local dx, dz = enemy.x - turret.x, enemy.z - turret.z
		local distSq = dx * dx + dz * dz
		if distSq < bestSq and not enemy.entering then
			local dist = math.sqrt(distSq)
			if dist < 0.5 or g:raycast(turret.x, turret.z, dx / dist, dz / dist, dist) >= dist - 0.5 then
				target, bestSq = enemy, distSq
			end
		end
	end
	if not target then
		return
	end
	local dist = math.sqrt(bestSq)
	local dx, dz = (target.x - turret.x) / math.max(dist, 1e-3), (target.z - turret.z) / math.max(dist, 1e-3)

	local context = KillContext.new(turret.owner)
	local wall = g:raycast(turret.x, turret.z, dx, dz, Config.TURRET_RANGE)
	local hits, travel = Hitscan.cast(turret.x, turret.z, dx, dz, wall, EnemyService.list(), enemyCircle, 1)
	for _, enemy in hits do
		EnemyService.damage(enemy, Config.TURRET_DAMAGE, context)
	end
	Scoring.flush(context)

	local facing = math.atan2(-dx, -dz)
	local head = turret.head
	if head then
		head:PivotTo(CFrame.new(turret.x, 3, turret.z) * CFrame.Angles(0, facing, 0))
	end
	local muzzle = Vector3.new(turret.x + dx * 2.4, 3.05, turret.z + dz * 2.4)
	local finish = Vector3.new(turret.x + dx * math.max(travel, 2.5), 3.05, turret.z + dz * math.max(travel, 2.5))
	ShotFired:FireAllClients(nil, "turret", muzzle, { finish }, 0)

	turret.fireReadyAt = clock + turret.fireInterval
	turret.ammo -= 1
	if turret.ammo <= 0 then
		Placeables.remove(turret)
		ExplosionRemote:FireAllClients(turret.x, turret.z, 0, "break")
	end
end

local function updateMine(mine: Placeable)
	local reach = Config.MINE_TRIGGER_RADIUS
	for _, enemy in EnemyService.list() do
		if not enemy.entering then
			local dx, dz = enemy.x - mine.x, enemy.z - mine.z
			local r = reach + enemy.radius
			if dx * dx + dz * dz <= r * r then
				Placeables.detonate(mine, 0, nil)
				return
			end
		end
	end
end

function Placeables.update(clock: number)
	local g = grid
	if not g then
		return
	end
	for _, placeable in table.clone(all) do
		if not placeable.alive or placeable.detonating then
			continue
		end
		if placeable.kind == "turret" then
			updateTurret(g, placeable, clock)
		elseif placeable.kind == "mine" then
			updateMine(placeable)
		end
	end
end

return Placeables

scripts.name: PlayerHealth
scripts.source:
--!strict
-- Damage to run players and their health regeneration
-- (HEALTH_REGEN_PER_SEC after HEALTH_REGEN_DELAY seconds without damage).
-- Roblox's own slow regen is switched off by the empty Health script in
-- StarterCharacterScripts.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Net = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Net)
local RunState = require(script.Parent.RunState)

local PlayerHurt = Net.event("PlayerHurt")

local PlayerHealth = {}

local lastHurt: { [Player]: number } = {}

local function humanoidOf(player: Player): Humanoid?
	local character = player.Character
	return if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
end

function PlayerHealth.damage(player: Player, amount: number)
	local participant = RunState.participants[player]
	local humanoid = humanoidOf(player)
	if not participant or not participant.alive or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or amount <= 0 then
		return
	end
	humanoid:TakeDamage(amount)
	lastHurt[player] = RunState.clock
	PlayerHurt:FireClient(player, amount)
end

function PlayerHealth.heal(player: Player)
	local humanoid = humanoidOf(player)
	if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
		humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth
	end
	lastHurt[player] = nil
end

function PlayerHealth.update(dt: number)
	for _, participant in RunState.alive() do
		local humanoid = humanoidOf(participant.player)
		if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and humanoid.Health < humanoid.MaxHealth then
			local since = RunState.clock - (lastHurt[participant.player] or -math.huge)
			if since >= Config.HEALTH_REGEN_DELAY then
				humanoid.Health = math.min(humanoid.MaxHealth, humanoid.Health + Config.HEALTH_REGEN_PER_SEC * dt)
			end
		end
	end
end

function PlayerHealth.forget(player: Player)
	lastHurt[player] = nil
end

return PlayerHealth

scripts.name: Projectiles
scripts.source:
--!strict
-- Things that fly: thrown grenades (land, then go off after their fuse),
-- rockets (explode on the first enemy, barrel or wall they touch) and devil
-- fireballs (hurt players, burn through zombies, set off barrels).
-- The server moves them; clients draw them from the spawn message.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Hitscan = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Hitscan)
local Net = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Net)
local WeaponStats = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.WeaponStats)
local Arena = require(script.Parent.Arena)
local EnemyService = require(script.Parent.EnemyService)
local Explosions = require(script.Parent.Explosions)
local Placeables = require(script.Parent.Placeables)
local PlayerHealth = require(script.Parent.PlayerHealth)
local RunState = require(script.Parent.RunState)

local ProjectileRemote = Net.event("Projectile")

type Projectile = {
	id: number,
	kind: string, -- grenade, rocket, fireball
	owner: Player?,
	x: number,
	z: number,
	dx: number,
	dz: number,
	speed: number,
	traveled: number,
	maxRange: number,
	damage: number,
	blastRadius: number,
	explodeAt: number,
	burned: { [number]: boolean }, -- enemies a fireball already hurt
}

local Projectiles = {}

local GRENADE_FLIGHT = 0.55 -- seconds in the air (for the client's arc)

local active: { Projectile } = {}
local lastId = 0

local function add(projectile: Projectile)
	table.insert(active, projectile)
end

local function newProjectile(kind: string, owner: Player?, x: number, z: number, dx: number, dz: number): Projectile
	lastId += 1
	return {
		id = lastId,
		kind = kind,
		owner = owner,
		x = x,
		z = z,
		dx = dx,
		dz = dz,
		speed = 0,
		traveled = 0,
		maxRange = 0,
		damage = 0,
		blastRadius = 0,
		explodeAt = math.huge,
		burned = {},
	}
end

function Projectiles.throwGrenade(owner: Player, x: number, z: number, dx: number, dz: number, distance: number, stats: WeaponStats.Stats)
	local grid = Arena.grid()
	local wall = grid:raycast(x, z, dx, dz, distance)
	local land = math.max(0, math.min(distance, wall - 1.2))
	local grenade = newProjectile("grenade", owner, x + dx * land, z + dz * land, dx, dz)
	grenade.explodeAt = RunState.clock + stats.fuse
	grenade.damage = stats.damage
	grenade.blastRadius = stats.blastRadius
	add(grenade)
	ProjectileRemote:FireAllClients("spawn", grenade.id, "grenade", x, z, grenade.x, grenade.z, GRENADE_FLIGHT, stats.fuse)
end

function Projectiles.fireRocket(owner: Player, x: number, z: number, dx: number, dz: number, stats: WeaponStats.Stats)
	local rocket = newProjectile("rocket", owner, x, z, dx, dz)
	rocket.speed = stats.speed
	rocket.maxRange = stats.range
	rocket.damage = stats.damage
	rocket.blastRadius = stats.blastRadius
	add(rocket)
	ProjectileRemote:FireAllClients("spawn", rocket.id, "rocket", x, z, dx, dz, rocket.speed)
end

function Projectiles.fireball(enemy: EnemyService.Enemy, targetX: number, targetZ: number)
	local dx, dz = targetX - enemy.x, targetZ - enemy.z
	local dist = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
	if dist < 1e-3 then
		return
	end
	dx, dz = dx / dist, dz / dist
	local ball = newProjectile("fireball", nil, enemy.x + dx * (enemy.radius + 0.5), enemy.z + dz * (enemy.radius + 0.5), dx, dz)
	ball.speed = Config.FIREBALL_SPEED
	ball.maxRange = (enemy.def.fireballRange or 45) + 15
	ball.burned[enemy.id] = true
	add(ball)
	ProjectileRemote:FireAllClients("spawn", ball.id, "fireball", ball.x, ball.z, dx, dz, ball.speed)
end

local function finish(index: number, x: number, z: number)
	local projectile = active[index]
	table.remove(active, index)
	ProjectileRemote:FireAllClients("end", projectile.id, x, z)
end

local function enemyCircle(enemy: EnemyService.Enemy): (number, number, number)
	return enemy.x, enemy.z, enemy.radius + 0.3
end

local function barrelCircle(barrel: Placeables.Placeable): (number, number, number)
	return barrel.x, barrel.z, Config.BARREL_RADIUS
end

-- Moves a rocket; returns where it blew up, if it did.
local function stepRocket(rocket: Projectile, dt: number): (number?, number?)
	local grid = Arena.grid()
	local stride = rocket.speed * dt
	local wall = grid:raycast(rocket.x, rocket.z, rocket.dx, rocket.dz, stride)
	local reach = math.min(stride, wall)
	local _, enemyAt = Hitscan.cast(rocket.x, rocket.z, rocket.dx, rocket.dz, reach, EnemyService.list(), enemyCircle, 1)
	local _, barrelAt = Hitscan.cast(rocket.x, rocket.z, rocket.dx, rocket.dz, reach, Placeables.barrels(), barrelCircle, 1)
	local stop = math.min(enemyAt, barrelAt)
	if stop < reach or wall < stride then
		local at = math.max(0, stop - 0.4)
		return rocket.x + rocket.dx * at, rocket.z + rocket.dz * at
	end
	rocket.x += rocket.dx * stride
	rocket.z += rocket.dz * stride
	rocket.traveled += stride
	if rocket.traveled >= rocket.maxRange then
		return rocket.x, rocket.z
	end
	return nil, nil
end

-- Moves a fireball; returns true when it is used up.
local function stepFireball(ball: Projectile, dt: number): boolean
	local grid = Arena.grid()
	local stride = ball.speed * dt
	if grid:raycast(ball.x, ball.z, ball.dx, ball.dz, stride) < stride then
		return true
	end
	ball.x += ball.dx * stride
	ball.z += ball.dz * stride
	ball.traveled += stride

	for _, participant in RunState.alive() do
		local character = participant.player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
			local dx, dz = root.Position.X - ball.x, root.Position.Z - ball.z
			local reach = Config.FIREBALL_RADIUS + Config.PLAYER_RADIUS
			if dx * dx + dz * dz <= reach * reach then
				PlayerHealth.damage(participant.player, Config.FIREBALL_DAMAGE * (Config.DIFFICULTIES[RunState.difficulty] or Config.DIFFICULTIES.Intermediate).damage)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	for _, barrel in Placeables.barrels() do
		local dx, dz = barrel.x - ball.x, barrel.z - ball.z
		local reach = Config.FIREBALL_RADIUS + Config.BARREL_RADIUS
		if dx * dx + dz * dz <= reach * reach then
			Placeables.detonate(barrel, 0, nil)
			return true
		end
	end

	-- Burns through zombies (but not other devils).
	for _, enemy in table.clone(EnemyService.list()) do
		if enemy.kind ~= "Devil" and not ball.burned[enemy.id] and not enemy.entering then
			local dx, dz = enemy.x - ball.x, enemy.z - ball.z
			local reach = Config.FIREBALL_RADIUS + enemy.radius
			if dx * dx + dz * dz <= reach * reach then
				ball.burned[enemy.id] = true
				EnemyService.damage(enemy, Config.FIREBALL_ENEMY_DAMAGE, nil)
			end
		end
	end
	return ball.traveled >= ball.maxRange
end

function Projectiles.update(dt: number, clock: number)
	for i = #active, 1, -1 do
		local projectile = active[i]
		if projectile.kind == "grenade" then
			if clock >= projectile.explodeAt then
				finish(i, projectile.x, projectile.z)
				Explosions.explode(projectile.x, projectile.z, projectile.blastRadius, projectile.damage, projectile.owner, "grenade")
			end
		elseif projectile.kind == "rocket" then
			local bx, bz = stepRocket(projectile, dt)
			if bx and bz then
				finish(i, bx, bz)
				Explosions.explode(bx, bz, projectile.blastRadius, projectile.damage, projectile.owner, "rocket")
			end
		elseif stepFireball(projectile, dt) then
			finish(i, projectile.x, projectile.z)
		end
	end
end

function Projectiles.clear()
	for i = #active, 1, -1 do
		finish(i, active[i].x, active[i].z)
	end
end

function Projectiles.start()
	EnemyService.hooks.shootFireball = Projectiles.fireball
end

return Projectiles

scripts.name: RoomBuilder
scripts.source:
--!strict
-- Turns a RoomGrid into parts: a checkered tile floor and block walls.
-- Neighbouring wall cells are merged into large rectangles to keep part count
-- low. Entry gaps get a short dark tunnel outside them for enemies to walk in
-- from, and an invisible barrier so players can't walk out.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local RoomGrid = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.RoomGrid)

local RoomBuilder = {}

local FLOOR_THICKNESS = 1
local TILE_RAISE = 0.04 -- the darker tiles sit a hair above the base floor to avoid flicker
local WALL_CAP = 0.4 -- thickness of the darker top of each wall
local TUNNEL_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(58, 56, 54)

local function block(name: string, size: Vector3, cframe: CFrame, color: Color3, parent: Instance): Part
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.Anchored = true
	part.Size = size
	part.CFrame = cframe
	part.Color = color
	part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.Parent = parent
	return part
end

local function buildFloor(grid: RoomGrid.RoomGrid, folder: Instance)
	local size = grid.cellSize
	local w, h = grid.width * size, grid.height * size
	local base = block(
		"Floor",
		Vector3.new(w, FLOOR_THICKNESS, h),
		CFrame.new(grid.originX + w / 2, -FLOOR_THICKNESS / 2, grid.originZ + h / 2),
		Config.FLOOR_COLOR_A,
		folder
	)
	base.CastShadow = false

	for r = 1, grid.height do
		for c = 1, grid.width do
			if (c + r) % 2 == 0 and grid:cell(c, r) ~= "#" then
				local x, z = grid:cellCenter(c, r)
				local tile = block("Tile", Vector3.new(size, 0.2, size), CFrame.new(x, TILE_RAISE - 0.1, z), Config.FLOOR_COLOR_B, folder)
				tile.CanCollide = false
				tile.CanQuery = false
				tile.CanTouch = false
				tile.CastShadow = false
			end
		end
	end
end

local function buildWalls(grid: RoomGrid.RoomGrid, folder: Instance)
	local size = grid.cellSize
	local used: { [number]: boolean } = {}
	local function key(c: number, r: number): number
		return r * 10000 + c
	end
	local function free(c: number, r: number): boolean
		return grid:inBounds(c, r) and grid:cell(c, r) == "#" and not used[key(c, r)]
	end

	for r = 1, grid.height do
		for c = 1, grid.width do
			if free(c, r) then
				-- Grow the widest run on this row, then extend it down while every cell matches.
				local runW = 1
				while free(c + runW, r) do
					runW += 1
				end
				local runH = 1
				while true do
					local rowOk = true
					for cc = c, c + runW - 1 do
						if not free(cc, r + runH) then
							rowOk = false
							break
						end
					end
					if not rowOk then
						break
					end
					runH += 1
				end
				for rr = r, r + runH - 1 do
					for cc = c, c + runW - 1 do
						used[key(cc, rr)] = true
					end
				end

				local x0, z0 = grid:cellCenter(c, r)
				local cx = x0 + (runW - 1) * size / 2
				local cz = z0 + (runH - 1) * size / 2
				local footW, footH = runW * size, runH * size
				local bodyHeight = Config.WALL_HEIGHT - WALL_CAP
				block("Wall", Vector3.new(footW, bodyHeight, footH), CFrame.new(cx, bodyHeight / 2, cz), Config.WALL_COLOR, folder)
				local cap = block("WallTop", Vector3.new(footW, WALL_CAP, footH), CFrame.new(cx, bodyHeight + WALL_CAP / 2, cz), Config.WALL_TOP_COLOR, folder)
				cap.CastShadow = false
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Direction pointing out of the room from an edge cell, or (0, 0) for inner cells.
function RoomBuilder.outward(grid: RoomGrid.RoomGrid, c: number, r: number): (number, number)
	if r == 1 then
		return 0, -1
	elseif r == grid.height then
		return 0, 1
	elseif c == 1 then
		return -1, 0
	elseif c == grid.width then
		return 1, 0
	end
	return 0, 0
end

local function buildEntries(grid: RoomGrid.RoomGrid, folder: Instance)
	local size = grid.cellSize
	for _, cell in grid:find("S") do
		local x, z = grid:cellCenter(cell.c, cell.r)
		local ox, oz = RoomBuilder.outward(grid, cell.c, cell.r)
		-- Dark tunnel floor outside the gap.
		local length = Config.ENEMY_ENTER_DISTANCE + size
		local tunnel = block(
			"Tunnel",
			Vector3.new(if ox ~= 0 then length else size, 0.4, if oz ~= 0 then length else size),
			CFrame.new(x + ox * (size / 2 + length / 2), -0.2, z + oz * (size / 2 + length / 2)),
			TUNNEL_COLOR,
			folder
		)
		tunnel.CastShadow = false
		-- Invisible barrier across the outer edge of the gap.
		local barrier = block(
			"Barrier",
			Vector3.new(if ox ~= 0 then 1 else size, 12, if oz ~= 0 then 1 else size),
			CFrame.new(x + ox * (size / 2 + 0.5), 6, z + oz * (size / 2 + 0.5)),
			Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
			folder
		)
		barrier.Transparency = 1
		barrier.CanQuery = false
	end
end

-- Builds the room into workspace[folderName], replacing whatever was there.
function RoomBuilder.build(grid: RoomGrid.RoomGrid, folderName: string): Folder
	local old = workspace:FindFirstChild(folderName)
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = folderName
	buildFloor(grid, folder)
	buildWalls(grid, folder)
	buildEntries(grid, folder)
	folder.Parent = workspace
	return folder
end

return RoomBuilder

scripts.name: RunManager
scripts.source:
--!strict
-- Runs one game at a time: GET READY, then waves that grow bigger and faster
-- forever, with a short break and "WAVE N" between them. When every player
-- is down it shows the results, saves high scores and hands the players back
-- (to the lobby, or teleports them home from a party server).

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Net = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Net)
local RoomGrid = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.RoomGrid)
local Rooms = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Rooms)
local WaveMath = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.WaveMath)
local AmmoBoxes = require(script.Parent.AmmoBoxes)
local Arena = require(script.Parent.Arena)
local CharacterService = require(script.Parent.CharacterService)
local EnemyService = require(script.Parent.EnemyService)
local HighScores = require(script.Parent.HighScores)
local Loadout = require(script.Parent.Loadout)
local PauseService = require(script.Parent.PauseService)
local Placeables = require(script.Parent.Placeables)
local PlayerHealth = require(script.Parent.PlayerHealth)
local Projectiles = require(script.Parent.Projectiles)
local RunState = require(script.Parent.RunState)
local Scoring = require(script.Parent.Scoring)

local Announce = Net.event("Announce")
local RunResults = Net.event("RunResults")
local ExplosionRemote = Net.event("Explosion")

export type FinishHandler = (players: { Player }) -> ()

local RunManager = {}

local entries: { RoomGrid.Cell } = {}
local onFinished: FinishHandler? = nil
local toSpawn = 0
local spawnInterval = 1
local nextSpawnAt = 0
local phaseEndsAt = 0
local speedMultiplier = 1
local damageMultiplier = 1
local runToken = 0 -- changes whenever a run starts or is cleaned up
local rng = Random.new()

local function announce(text: string, style: string)
	for player in RunState.participants do
		Announce:FireClient(player, text, style)
	end
end

local function rootOf(player: Player): BasePart?
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	return if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then root else nil
end

local function targets(): { EnemyService.Target }
	local list: { EnemyService.Target } = {}
	for _, participant in RunState.alive() do
		local root = rootOf(participant.player)
		if root then
			table.insert(list, { player = participant.player, x = root.Position.X, z = root.Position.Z })
		end
	end
	return list
end

local function beginWave(wave: number)
	local difficulty = Config.DIFFICULTIES[RunState.difficulty]
	RunState.wave = wave
	RunState.phase = "Wave"
	toSpawn = WaveMath.count(wave, RunState.count(), difficulty)
	spawnInterval = Config.WAVE_SPAWN_TIME / toSpawn
	nextSpawnAt = RunState.clock
	speedMultiplier = WaveMath.speedMultiplier(wave, difficulty)
	RunState.publish()
	if wave == 1 then
		announce("WAVE 1", "wave")
	end
end

local function spawnOne()
	if #entries == 0 then
		toSpawn = 0
		return
	end
	local cell = entries[rng:NextInteger(1, #entries)]
	EnemyService.spawn(WaveMath.pickKind(RunState.wave, rng:NextNumber()), cell, speedMultiplier, damageMultiplier)
end

local function reviveFallen()
	for player, participant in RunState.participants do
		if not participant.alive and player.Parent then
			participant.alive = true
			task.spawn(CharacterService.spawnAt, player, Arena.spawnFor(participant.slot))
			Announce:FireClient(player, "BACK IN THE FIGHT", "info")
		end
	end
end

local function cleanup()
	runToken += 1
	local players: { Player } = {}
	for player in RunState.participants do
		table.insert(players, player)
		player:SetAttribute("InRun", nil)
		Loadout.clear(player)
		PlayerHealth.forget(player)
	end
	EnemyService.clear()
	Projectiles.clear()
	Placeables.clear()
	AmmoBoxes.clear()
	Scoring.clear()
	table.clear(RunState.participants)
	RunState.active = false
	RunState.phase = "Idle"
	RunState.wave = 0
	RunState.publish()
	local finished = onFinished
	onFinished = nil
	if finished then
		finished(players)
	end
end

local function finishRun()
	if not RunState.active or RunState.phase == "Over" then
		return
	end
	RunState.phase = "Over"
	RunState.publish()
	PauseService.set(false)
	local results = Scoring.results()
	local summary = {
		wave = RunState.wave,
		room = RunState.roomId,
		difficulty = RunState.difficulty,
		players = results,
		returnIn = Config.RESULTS_TIME,
	}
	for player in RunState.participants do
		RunResults:FireClient(player, summary)
	end
	local roomId, difficulty = RunState.roomId, RunState.difficulty
	task.spawn(function()
		for _, result in results do
			HighScores.submit(roomId, difficulty, result.userId, result.score)
		end
	end)
	local token = runToken
	task.delay(Config.RESULTS_TIME, function()
		if token == runToken then
			cleanup()
		end
	end)
end

local function checkAllDown()
	if RunState.active and RunState.phase ~= "Over" and #RunState.alive() == 0 then
		finishRun()
	end
end

local function onDied(player: Player)
	local participant = RunState.participants[player]
	if not participant or not participant.alive then
		return
	end
	participant.alive = false
	local root = rootOf(player)
	if root then
		ExplosionRemote:FireAllClients(root.Position.X, root.Position.Z, 0, "death")
	end
	Announce:FireClient(player, "YOU DIED", "big")
	checkAllDown()
end

local function onLeave(player: Player)
	if not RunState.participants[player] then
		return
	end
	RunState.participants[player] = nil
	Scoring.remove(player)
	if RunState.count() == 0 then
		cleanup()
	else
		checkAllDown()
	end
end

local function step(dt: number)
	if not RunState.active or RunState.paused then
		return
	end
	if RunState.phase == "Over" then
		EnemyService.flush()
		return
	end
	RunState.clock += dt
	local clock = RunState.clock
	EnemyService.update(dt, clock, targets())
	Projectiles.update(dt, clock)
	Placeables.update(clock)
	AmmoBoxes.update(dt)
	PlayerHealth.update(dt)

	if RunState.phase == "Starting" then
		if clock >= phaseEndsAt then
			beginWave(1)
		end
	elseif RunState.phase == "Wave" then
		while toSpawn > 0 and clock >= nextSpawnAt and EnemyService.count() < Config.MAX_ALIVE_ENEMIES do
			spawnOne()
			toSpawn -= 1
			nextSpawnAt += spawnInterval
		end
		if toSpawn > 0 and EnemyService.count() >= Config.MAX_ALIVE_ENEMIES then
			nextSpawnAt = math.max(nextSpawnAt, clock) -- don't save up a burst while full
		end
		if toSpawn == 0 and EnemyService.count() == 0 then
			RunState.phase = "Break"
			phaseEndsAt = clock + Config.WAVE_BREAK
			RunState.publish()
			if Config.REVIVE_AT_WAVE_END then
				reviveFallen()
			end
			announce("WAVE " .. (RunState.wave + 1), "wave")
		end
	elseif RunState.phase == "Break" then
		if clock >= phaseEndsAt then
			beginWave(RunState.wave + 1)
		end
	end
end

-- Starts a run in this server's arena. Returns false if one is already going.
function RunManager.begin(players: { Player }, roomId: string, difficulty: string, finished: FinishHandler): boolean
	if RunState.active or #players == 0 then
		return false
	end
	if not Rooms.ARENAS[roomId] then
		roomId = Rooms.ORDER[1]
	end
	if not Config.DIFFICULTIES[difficulty] then
		difficulty = "Intermediate"
	end
	local grid = Arena.load(roomId)
	entries = grid:find("S")

	runToken += 1
	RunState.active = true
	RunState.phase = "Starting"
	RunState.clock = 0
	RunState.roomId = roomId
	RunState.difficulty = difficulty
	RunState.wave = 0
	table.clear(RunState.participants)
	for slot, player in players do
		RunState.participants[player] = { player = player, slot = slot, alive = true }
		CharacterService.setSlot(player, slot)
		player:SetAttribute("InRun", true)
		Loadout.reset(player)
		PlayerHealth.forget(player)
	end
	Scoring.reset(players)
	EnemyService.start(grid)
	Placeables.start(grid)
	AmmoBoxes.start(grid)
	onFinished = finished
	damageMultiplier = Config.DIFFICULTIES[difficulty].damage
	phaseEndsAt = Config.RUN_START_DELAY
	PauseService.set(false)
	RunState.publish()

	for player, participant in RunState.participants do
		task.spawn(CharacterService.spawnAt, player, Arena.spawnFor(participant.slot))
	end
	announce("GET READY", "wave")
	return true
end

function RunManager.init()
	EnemyService.hooks.attackPlayer = PlayerHealth.damage
	CharacterService.Died:Connect(onDied)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onLeave)
	RunState.PausedChanged:Connect(function(paused: boolean, seconds: number)
		if not paused and seconds > 0 then
			Scoring.shiftAll(seconds)
		end
	end)
	RunState.publish()
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(step)
end

return RunManager

scripts.source:
--!strict
-- Shared state of the current run (one at a time per server), read by every
-- server system. RunManager is the only module that changes it, apart from
-- PauseService toggling `paused`.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Signal = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Signal)

export type Participant = {
	player: Player,
	slot: number, -- 1-6: spawn cell and shirt order
	alive: boolean,
}

local RunState = {}

RunState.active = false
RunState.phase = "Idle" -- Idle, Starting, Wave, Break, Over
RunState.paused = false
RunState.clock = 0 -- seconds of unpaused run time; cooldowns use this
RunState.roomId = ""
RunState.difficulty = "Intermediate"
RunState.wave = 0
RunState.participants = {} :: { [Player]: Participant }
RunState.PausedChanged = Signal.new() -- (paused: boolean, pausedForSeconds: number)

function RunState.isParticipant(player: Player): boolean
	return RunState.participants[player] ~= nil
end

-- True while this player may shoot, place and pick things up.
function RunState.canAct(player: Player): boolean
	local participant = RunState.participants[player]
	return RunState.active
		and not RunState.paused
		and participant ~= nil
		and participant.alive
		and RunState.phase ~= "Over"
		and RunState.phase ~= "Idle"
end

function RunState.alive(): { Participant }
	local list = {}
	for _, participant in RunState.participants do
		if participant.alive then
			table.insert(list, participant)
		end
	end
	return list
end

function RunState.count(): number
	local n = 0
	for _ in RunState.participants do
		n += 1
	end
	return n
end

-- Mirrors the run's state onto ReplicatedStorage so clients can show it.
function RunState.publish()
	ReplicatedStorage:SetAttribute("RunActive", RunState.active)
	ReplicatedStorage:SetAttribute("RunPhase", RunState.phase)
	ReplicatedStorage:SetAttribute("Wave", RunState.wave)
	ReplicatedStorage:SetAttribute("RoomId", RunState.roomId)
	ReplicatedStorage:SetAttribute("Difficulty", RunState.difficulty)
end

return RunState

--!strict
-- Floating high score boards in the lobby, one per difficulty, each cycling
-- through the rooms. Data is fetched slowly in the background to stay inside
-- Roblox's DataStore request budget.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Rooms = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Rooms)
local HighScores = require(script.Parent.HighScores)
local LobbyBuilder = require(script.Parent.LobbyBuilder)

type Board = { difficulty: string, title: TextLabel, rows: { TextLabel }, roomIndex: number }
type Cached = { rows: { HighScores.Row }?, fetchedAt: number }

local Scoreboards = {}

local FETCH_GAP = 7 -- seconds between DataStore reads
local STALE_AFTER = 120

local boards: { Board } = {}
local cache: { [string]: Cached } = {}
local wanted: { string } = {}

local function key(roomId: string, difficulty: string): string
	return roomId .. "|" .. difficulty
end

local function render(board: Board)
	local roomId = Rooms.ORDER[board.roomIndex]
	board.title.Text = Rooms.ARENAS[roomId].name .. "  -  " .. string.upper(board.difficulty)
	local entry = cache[key(roomId, board.difficulty)]
	for i, row in board.rows do
		local data = entry and entry.rows and entry.rows[i]
		if data then
			row.Text = string.format("%d. %s   %d", i, data.name, data.score)
		elseif i == 1 then
			row.Text = if entry == nil then "loading..." elseif entry.rows == nil then "scores need a published game" else "no scores yet"
		else
			row.Text = ""
		end
	end
	local entryKey = key(roomId, board.difficulty)
	if (entry == nil or os.clock() - entry.fetchedAt > STALE_AFTER) and not table.find(wanted, entryKey) then
		table.insert(wanted, entryKey)
	end
end

function Scoreboards.start(anchors: { Vector3 }, parent: Instance)
	for i, at in anchors do
		local difficulty = Config.DIFFICULTY_ORDER[i]
		if not difficulty then
			break
		end
		local gui = LobbyBuilder.sign(parent, at, 20, 12)
		local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
		frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(26, 26, 34)
		frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
		frame.Parent = gui
		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.06, 0)
		corner.Parent = frame
		local function line(y: number, h: number, color: Color3): TextLabel
			local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			text.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, y)
			text.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, h)
			text.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
			text.TextScaled = true
			text.TextColor3 = color
			text.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			text.Text = ""
			text.Parent = frame
			return text
		end
		local title = line(0.03, 0.14, Color3.fromRGB(240, 196, 60))
		local rows = {}
		for r = 1, Config.SCOREBOARD_SIZE do
			table.insert(rows, line(0.2 + (r - 1) * 0.095, 0.085, Color3.new(1, 1, 1)))
		end
		local board = { difficulty = difficulty, title = title, rows = rows, roomIndex = 1 }
		table.insert(boards, board)
		render(board)
	end

	-- Cycle rooms on every board.
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(Config.SCOREBOARD_CYCLE)
			for _, board in boards do
				board.roomIndex = board.roomIndex % #Rooms.ORDER + 1
				render(board)
			end
		end
	end)

	-- Fetch one board's data at a time.
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			local nextKey = table.remove(wanted, 1)
			if nextKey then
				local roomId, difficulty = string.match(nextKey, "^(.-)|(.*)$")
				if roomId and difficulty then
					cache[nextKey] = { rows = HighScores.top(roomId, difficulty, Config.SCOREBOARD_SIZE), fetchedAt = os.clock() }
					for _, board in boards do
						render(board)
					end
				end
			end
			task.wait(FETCH_GAP)
		end
	end)
end

return Scoreboards

--!strict
-- Each run player's multiplier, score and kills. Kills arrive in batches
-- (one shot, blast or turret burst) so several at once earn the bonus.
-- Values are mirrored onto Player attributes for the HUD and teammate list.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Combo = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Combo)
local Net = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Net)
local Unlocks = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Unlocks)
local WeaponStats = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.WeaponStats)
local KillContext = require(script.Parent.KillContext)
local Loadout = require(script.Parent.Loadout)

local Announce = Net.event("Announce")

type Entry = { combo: Combo.State, score: number, kills: number }

export type Result = { userId: number, name: string, score: number, kills: number }

local Scoring = {}

local entries: { [Player]: Entry } = {}

local function publish(player: Player, entry: Entry?)
	player:SetAttribute("Mult", if entry then entry.combo.base else nil)
	player:SetAttribute("MultGraceEnd", if entry then entry.combo.graceEnd else nil)
	player:SetAttribute("Score", if entry then entry.score else nil)
	player:SetAttribute("Kills", if entry then entry.kills else nil)
end

function Scoring.reset(players: { Player })
	Scoring.clear()
	for _, player in players do
		local entry = { combo = Combo.new(), score = 0, kills = 0 }
		entries[player] = entry
		publish(player, entry)
	end
end

function Scoring.clear()
	for player in entries do
		publish(player, nil)
	end
	table.clear(entries)
end

function Scoring.remove(player: Player)
	entries[player] = nil
	publish(player, nil)
end

-- Scores the kills collected in a context and hands out any unlocks earned.
function Scoring.flush(context: KillContext.KillContext)
	local owner = context.owner
	if #context.kills == 0 or not owner then
		return
	end
	local entry = entries[owner]
	if not entry then
		return
	end
	local points, reached = Combo.addKills(entry.combo, workspace:GetServerTimeNow(), context.kills)
	entry.score += points
	entry.kills += #context.kills
	table.clear(context.kills)
	publish(owner, entry)

	for _, unlock in reached do
		Loadout.unlock(owner, unlock)
		local label = WeaponStats.unlockLabel(unlock.weapon, unlock.upgrade, Unlocks.UPGRADE_NAMES)
		if not unlock.upgrade then
			label ..= "  [" .. Loadout.keyLabel(unlock.weapon) .. "]"
		end
		Announce:FireClient(owner, label, "unlock")
	end
end

-- Pushes every drain timer back, e.g. after a pause.
function Scoring.shiftAll(seconds: number)
	for player, entry in entries do
		Combo.shift(entry.combo, seconds)
		publish(player, entry)
	end
end

function Scoring.results(): { Result }
	local list: { Result } = {}
	for player, entry in entries do
		table.insert(list, { userId = player.UserId, name = player.DisplayName, score = entry.score, kills = entry.kills })
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		return a.score > b.score
	end)
	return list
end

return Scoring

scripts.source:
--!strict
-- Sends a party into a game. In the published game the party is teleported
-- to its own private (reserved) server of this same place. In Studio, where
-- teleports don't work, the run happens right here in this server's arena.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Net = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Net)
local CharacterService = require(script.Parent.CharacterService)
local RunManager = require(script.Parent.RunManager)

local Announce = Net.event("Announce")

local Teleporter = {}

-- Where players go when a run in this server ends. Set by Main.
Teleporter.homeSpawn = function(_player: Player): CFrame?
	return nil
end

local function present(players: { Player }): { Player }
	local list = {}
	for _, player in players do
		if player.Parent == Players then
			table.insert(list, player)
		end
	end
	return list
end

-- Plays the run in this server's own arena.
function Teleporter.playHere(players: { Player }, roomId: string, difficulty: string)
	local started = RunManager.begin(players, roomId, difficulty, function(finished: { Player })
		for _, player in finished do
			local home = Teleporter.homeSpawn(player)
			if player.Parent and home then
				task.spawn(CharacterService.spawnAt, player, home)
			end
		end
	end)
	if not started then
		for _, player in players do
			Announce:FireClient(player, "ARENA BUSY - TRY AGAIN IN A MOMENT", "info")
		end
	end
end

function Teleporter.launch(players: { Player }, roomId: string, difficulty: string)
	if RunService:IsStudio() then
		Teleporter.playHere(players, roomId, difficulty)
		return
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		local userIds = {}
		for _, player in players do
			table.insert(userIds, player.UserId)
			Announce:FireClient(player, "TELEPORTING...", "info")
		end
		local options = Instance.new("TeleportOptions")
		options.ShouldReserveServer = true
		options:SetTeleportData({ room = roomId, difficulty = difficulty, party = userIds })
		for attempt = 1, Config.TELEPORT_RETRIES do
			local group = present(players)
			if #group == 0 then
				return
			end
			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				return TeleportService:TeleportAsync(game.PlaceId, group, options)
			end)
			if ok then
				return
			end
			warn("[Block Horde] party teleport failed (attempt " .. attempt .. "): " .. tostring(err))
			task.wait(2 * attempt)
		end
		-- Teleports keep failing: play in this server instead.
		Teleporter.playHere(present(players), roomId, difficulty)
	end)
end

-- From a party's private server: send everyone back to a lobby server.
function Teleporter.sendHome(players: { Player })
	task.spawn(function()
		for attempt = 1, 10 do
			local group = present(players)
			if #group == 0 then
				return
			end
			for _, player in group do
				Announce:FireClient(player, "BACK TO THE LOBBY...", "info")
			end
			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				return TeleportService:TeleportAsync(game.PlaceId, group)
			end)
			if ok then
				return
			end
			warn("[Block Horde] teleport home failed (attempt " .. attempt .. "): " .. tostring(err))
			task.wait(5)
		end
	end)
end

function Teleporter.start()
	TeleportService.TeleportInitFailed:Connect(function(player: Player, _result: Enum.TeleportResult, message: string)
		Announce:FireClient(player, "TELEPORT FAILED: " .. message, "info")
	end)
end

return Teleporter

scripts.name: WeaponService
scripts.source:
--!strict
-- Checks every shot a client asks for (in a run, alive, owns the weapon, fire
-- rate, ammo) and carries it out: hitscan bullets against the enemy table and
-- barrels, thrown grenades, rockets, or dropping a placeable on the cell in
-- front. Hitscan shots are echoed to every client so they can draw tracers;
-- the shooter already drew theirs instantly.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Hitscan = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Hitscan)
local Net = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Net)
local WeaponStats = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.WeaponStats)
local Arena = require(script.Parent.Arena)
local EnemyService = require(script.Parent.EnemyService)
local KillContext = require(script.Parent.KillContext)
local Loadout = require(script.Parent.Loadout)
local Placeables = require(script.Parent.Placeables)
local Projectiles = require(script.Parent.Projectiles)
local RunState = require(script.Parent.RunState)
local Scoring = require(script.Parent.Scoring)

local Fire = Net.event("Fire")
local ShotFired = Net.event("ShotFired")

local WeaponService = {}

-- Per player, per weapon: the earliest time the next shot is allowed.
local nextShotAt: { [Player]: { [string]: number } } = {}
-- Grenades thrown in quick succession fly further.
local lastThrow: { [Player]: { at: number, distance: number } } = {}

local function enemyCircle(enemy: EnemyService.Enemy): (number, number, number)
	return enemy.x, enemy.z, enemy.radius
end

local function barrelCircle(barrel: Placeables.Placeable): (number, number, number)
	return barrel.x, barrel.z, Config.BARREL_RADIUS
end

-- Fires every pellet of a hitscan shot. Returns where each visible bullet stopped.
local function fireHitscan(player: Player, stats: WeaponStats.Stats, pos: Vector3, dirX: number, dirZ: number, seed: number, context: KillContext.KillContext): { Vector3 }
	local grid = Arena.grid()
	local y = pos.Y + Config.MUZZLE_HEIGHT
	local endpoints: { Vector3 } = {}
	for _, dir in WeaponStats.pelletDirections(dirX, dirZ, stats, seed) do
		local dx, dz = dir[1], dir[2]
		local wall = grid:raycast(pos.X, pos.Z, dx, dz, stats.range)
		local enemies, _, enemyDists = Hitscan.cast(pos.X, pos.Z, dx, dz, wall, EnemyService.list(), enemyCircle, math.huge)
		local barrels, _, barrelDists = Hitscan.cast(pos.X, pos.Z, dx, dz, wall, Placeables.barrels(), barrelCircle, math.huge)

		-- Walk the hits nearest first until the bullet has gone through `pierce` things.
		local ei, bi, taken = 1, 1, 0
		local travel = wall
		while taken < stats.pierce do
			local enemyDist, barrelDist = enemyDists[ei], barrelDists[bi]
			if enemyDist == nil and barrelDist == nil then
				break
			end
			if barrelDist == nil or (enemyDist ~= nil and enemyDist <= barrelDist) then
				EnemyService.damage(enemies[ei], stats.damage, context)
				travel = enemyDist
				ei += 1
			else
				Placeables.detonate(barrels[bi], 0, player)
				travel = barrelDist
				bi += 1
			end
			taken += 1
		end
		if taken < stats.pierce then
			travel = wall
		end
		if travel > Config.MUZZLE_FORWARD then
			table.insert(endpoints, Vector3.new(pos.X + dx * travel, y, pos.Z + dz * travel))
		end
	end
	return endpoints
end

local function onFire(player: Player, weaponId: unknown, dirX: unknown, dirZ: unknown, seed: unknown)
	if typeof(weaponId) ~= "string" or typeof(dirX) ~= "number" or typeof(dirZ) ~= "number" then
		return
	end
	if not Config.WEAPONS[weaponId] or not RunState.canAct(player) or not Loadout.owns(player, weaponId) then
		return
	end
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end
	local length = math.sqrt(dirX * dirX + dirZ * dirZ)
	if length ~= length or length < 0.01 then
		return -- NaN or zero direction
	end
	local dx, dz = dirX / length, dirZ / length
	local shotSeed = if typeof(seed) == "number" and seed == seed then math.floor(math.abs(seed)) % 1073741824 else 1

	local stats = Loadout.stats(player, weaponId)

	-- Fire rate check, with half an interval of slack for network jitter.
	local now = os.clock()
	local times = nextShotAt[player]
	if not times then
		times = {}
		nextShotAt[player] = times
	end
	local allowedAt = times[weaponId] or 0
	if now < allowedAt - stats.fireInterval * 0.5 then
		return
	end
	times[weaponId] = math.max(allowedAt, now) + stats.fireInterval

	if not Loadout.useAmmo(player, weaponId) then
		return
	end

	local pos = root.Position
	if stats.kind == "hitscan" then
		local context = KillContext.new(player)
		local endpoints = fireHitscan(player, stats, pos, dx, dz, shotSeed, context)
		Scoring.flush(context)
		EnemyService.flush()
		local muzzle = Vector3.new(pos.X + dx * Config.MUZZLE_FORWARD, pos.Y + Config.MUZZLE_HEIGHT, pos.Z + dz * Config.MUZZLE_FORWARD)
		ShotFired:FireAllClients(player, weaponId, muzzle, endpoints, shotSeed)
	elseif stats.kind == "grenade" then
		local last = lastThrow[player]
		local distance = stats.throwDistance
		if last and now - last.at <= stats.throwComboWindow then
			distance = math.min(last.distance + stats.throwStep, stats.throwMax)
		end
		lastThrow[player] = { at = now, distance = distance }
		Projectiles.throwGrenade(player, pos.X, pos.Z, dx, dz, distance, stats)
	elseif stats.kind == "rocket" then
		Projectiles.fireRocket(player, pos.X, pos.Z, dx, dz, stats)
	elseif stats.kind == "place" then
		local grid = Arena.grid()
		local ahead = grid.cellSize * 1.1
		local c, r = grid:worldToCell(pos.X + dx * ahead, pos.Z + dz * ahead)
		if not Placeables.place(player, stats.place or "", c, r, stats) then
			Loadout.refund(player, weaponId)
		end
	end
end

function WeaponService.start()
	Fire.OnServerEvent:Connect(onFire)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		nextShotAt[player] = nil
		lastThrow[player] = nil
	end)
end

return WeaponService

scripts.source:
--!strict
-- Overhead camera: high above the player, tilted a little to look north,
-- narrow field of view. Smooth follow, no zoom, no rotation. Shakes on
-- explosions. When you are down during a run it follows a living teammate
-- (Q / E to switch).

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Config"))
local CharacterController = require(script.Parent.CharacterController)
local Input = require(script.Parent.InputController)

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local CameraController = {}

local focus: Vector3? = nil
local trauma = 0
local spectateIndex = 1
local spectating: Player? = nil

-- Adds shake; amount 1 is the strongest.
function CameraController.shake(amount: number)
	trauma = math.min(1, trauma + amount)
end

function CameraController.spectating(): Player?
	return spectating
end

local function livingTeammates(): { Player }
	local list = {}
	for _, other in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local character = other.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if other ~= player and other:GetAttribute("InRun") == true and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			table.insert(list, other)
		end
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		return a.UserId < b.UserId
	end)
	return list
end

local function rootOf(target: Player): BasePart?
	local character = target.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	return if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then root else nil
end

local function pickTarget(): BasePart?
	spectating = nil
	local root = CharacterController.getRoot()
	if root and CharacterController.isAlive() then
		return root
	end
	if player:GetAttribute("InRun") ~= true then
		return root
	end
	local mates = livingTeammates()
	if #mates == 0 then
		return root
	end
	spectateIndex = (spectateIndex - 1) % #mates + 1
	spectating = mates[spectateIndex]
	return rootOf(mates[spectateIndex])
end

local function update(dt: number)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if camera.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	end
	if camera.FieldOfView ~= Config.CAMERA_FOV then
		camera.FieldOfView = Config.CAMERA_FOV
	end

	local root = pickTarget()
	if root then
		local target = Vector3.new(root.Position.X, 0, root.Position.Z)
		if focus and (focus - target).Magnitude < 150 then
			focus = focus:Lerp(target, 1 - math.exp(-Config.CAMERA_FOLLOW_SHARPNESS * dt))
		else
			focus = target -- first frame, or teleported far (lobby <-> arena): snap
		end
	end

	local at = focus or Vector3.zero
	local tilt = math.rad(Config.CAMERA_TILT_DEG)
	local distance = Config.CAMERA_DISTANCE
	local eye = at + Vector3.new(0, distance * math.cos(tilt), distance * math.sin(tilt))
	local cframe = CFrame.lookAt(eye, at)
	if trauma > 0 then
		local amount = trauma * trauma * Config.CAMERA_SHAKE_MAX
		cframe += cframe.RightVector * (math.random() * 2 - 1) * amount + cframe.UpVector * (math.random() * 2 - 1) * amount
		trauma = math.max(0, trauma - dt / Config.CAMERA_SHAKE_TIME)
	end
	camera.CFrame = cframe
end

function CameraController.start()
	Input.CycleWeapon:Connect(function(step: number)
		if spectating then
			spectateIndex += step
		end
	end)
	RunService:BindToRenderStep("BlockHordeCamera", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, update)
end

return CameraController

scripts.source:
--!strict
-- Moves the local character from input and turns it to face the aim direction.
-- Jumping is off and Humanoid.AutoRotate is off; facing is set here.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Config"))
local Input = require(script.Parent.InputController)

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local CharacterController = {}

local humanoid: Humanoid? = nil
local root: BasePart? = nil
local align: AlignOrientation? = nil
local facing = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)

function CharacterController.getRoot(): BasePart?
	return root
end

-- Unit vector on the floor plane the character is facing (and shooting toward).
function CharacterController.getFacing(): Vector3
	return facing
end

function CharacterController.isAlive(): boolean
	return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0 and humanoid.Parent ~= nil
end

local function flat(v: Vector3): Vector3?
	local f = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
	if f.Magnitude < 1e-3 then
		return nil
	end
	return f.Unit
end

local function setup(character: Model)
	local h = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid") :: Humanoid
	local r = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart
	h.AutoRotate = false
	h:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, false)

	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Name = "FacingAttachment"
	attachment.Parent = r
	local a = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
	a.Name = "Facing"
	a.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
	a.Attachment0 = attachment
	a.RigidityEnabled = true
	a.Parent = r

	facing = flat(r.CFrame.LookVector) or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	a.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, facing)
	humanoid, root, align = h, r, a
end

local function update()
	local h, r, a = humanoid, root, align
	if not h or not r or not a or not h.Parent then
		return
	end
	if workspace:GetAttribute("Paused") == true or h.Health <= 0 then
		h:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
		return
	end

	local move = Input.getMoveVector()
	h:Move(move, false)

	local aim: Vector3? = nil
	if Input.scheme == "Mouse" then
		local point = Input.getMouseGroundPoint(r.Position.Y + Config.MUZZLE_HEIGHT)
		if point then
			local toPoint = point - r.Position
			if Vector3.new(toPoint.X, 0, toPoint.Z).Magnitude > 0.5 then
				aim = flat(toPoint)
			end
		end
	elseif move.Magnitude > 0.1 then
		aim = flat(move)
	end
	if aim then
		facing = aim
	end
	a.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, facing)
end

function CharacterController.start()
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(setup)
	if player.Character then
		task.spawn(setup, player.Character)
	end
	RunService:BindToRenderStep("BlockHordeCharacter", Enum.RenderPriority.Input.Value + 1, update)
end

return CharacterController
