scripts.source:
--!strict
-- The client's copy of the current arena grid, rebuilt from the RoomId
-- attribute the server sets. Fake walls players drop are mirrored into it so
-- instant tracers stop at them, and barrels are listed for the same reason.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local Config = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Config"))
local RoomGrid = require(Shared:WaitForChild("RoomGrid"))
local Rooms = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Rooms"))

export type Circle = { x: number, z: number, radius: number }

local ClientArena = {}

local current: RoomGrid.RoomGrid? = nil

local function propsFolder(): Instance?
	local arena = workspace:FindFirstChild("Arena")
	return arena and arena:FindFirstChild("Props")
end

local function syncWalls()
	local grid = current
	local props = propsFolder()
	if not grid or not props then
		return
	end
	-- Start from the plain map, then add every fake wall standing now.
	for r = 1, grid.height do
		for c = 1, grid.width do
			grid:setBlocked(c, r, grid:cell(c, r) == "#")
		end
	end
	for _, model in props:GetChildren() do
		local c, r = model:GetAttribute("CellC"), model:GetAttribute("CellR")
		if model:GetAttribute("Kind") == "wall" and typeof(c) == "number" and typeof(r) == "number" then
			grid:setBlocked(c, r, true)
		end
	end
end

local function rebuild()
	local roomId = ReplicatedStorage:GetAttribute("RoomId")
	if typeof(roomId) == "string" and Rooms.ARENAS[roomId] then
		current = RoomGrid.new(Rooms.ARENAS[roomId], Config.CELL_SIZE)
		syncWalls()
	else
		current = nil
	end
end

local function watchArena(arena: Instance)
	local props = arena:WaitForChild("Props", 10)
	if props then
		props.ChildAdded:Connect(syncWalls)
		props.ChildRemoved:Connect(syncWalls)
		syncWalls()
	end
end

function ClientArena.grid(): RoomGrid.RoomGrid?
	return current
end

function ClientArena.barrels(): { Circle }
	local list: { Circle } = {}
	local props = propsFolder()
	if props then
		for _, model in props:GetChildren() do
			if model:IsA("Model") and model:GetAttribute("Kind") == "barrel" then
				local p = model:GetPivot().Position
				table.insert(list, { x = p.X, z = p.Z, radius = Config.BARREL_RADIUS })
			end
		end
	end
	return list
end

function ClientArena.start()
	rebuild()
	ReplicatedStorage:GetAttributeChangedSignal("RoomId"):Connect(rebuild)
	workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		if child.Name == "Arena" then
			task.spawn(watchArena, child)
		end
	end)
	local arena = workspace:FindFirstChild("Arena")
	if arena then
		task.spawn(watchArena, arena)
	end
end

return ClientArena

scripts.name: Effects
scripts.source:
--!strict
-- Short-lived visual effects drawn only on this client: tracers, railgun
-- beams, muzzle flashes, cartoon explosions with block debris, death bursts,
-- blood splats that stay on the floor (oldest fade past SPLAT_MAX) and puffs.
-- Parts are pooled and reused instead of created per effect.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Config"))
local CameraController = require(script.Parent.CameraController)
local Sounds = require(script.Parent.Sounds)

local Effects = {}

type Fading = {
	part: Part,
	born: number,
	life: number,
	startTransparency: number,
	fromSize: Vector3?,
	toSize: Vector3?,
	center: CFrame?,
}

type Chunk = {
	part: Part,
	velocity: Vector3,
	spin: Vector3,
	born: number,
	life: number,
}

local HIDDEN = CFrame.new(0, -10000, 0)
local GRAVITY = 80
local ORANGE = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 30)
local YELLOW_WHITE = Color3.fromRGB(255, 244, 190)
local BLOOD = Color3.fromRGB(150, 16, 16)

local folder: Folder
local pool: { Part } = {}
local fading: { Fading } = {}
local chunks: { Chunk } = {}
local splats: { Part } = {}
local rng = Random.new()

local function newPart(): Part
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CastShadow = false
	part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.Parent = folder
	return part
end

local function take(shape: Enum.PartType, material: Enum.Material, color: Color3): Part
	local part = table.remove(pool) or newPart()
	part.Shape = shape
	part.Material = material
	part.Color = color
	part.Transparency = 0
	return part
end

local function release(part: Part)
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.CFrame = HIDDEN
	table.insert(pool, part)
end

-- Fades a part out over `life` seconds, optionally growing it.
local function fade(part: Part, life: number, fromSize: Vector3?, toSize: Vector3?)
	local center = if fromSize then part.CFrame else nil
	table.insert(fading, {
		part = part,
		born = os.clock(),
		life = life,
		startTransparency = part.Transparency,
		fromSize = fromSize,
		toSize = toSize,
		center = center,
	})
end

local function debris(at: Vector3, colors: { Color3 }, count: number, speed: number, size: number)
	for _ = 1, count do
		local part = take(Enum.PartType.Block, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, colors[rng:NextInteger(1, #colors)])
		local s = size * rng:NextNumber(0.6, 1.3)
		part.Size = Vector3.new(s, s, s)
		part.CFrame = CFrame.new(at + Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(-0.6, 0.6), rng:NextNumber(0, 1.5), rng:NextNumber(-0.6, 0.6)))
		local angle = rng:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2)
		local outward = rng:NextNumber(0.4, 1) * speed
		table.insert(chunks, {
			part = part,
			velocity = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * outward, rng:NextNumber(0.8, 1.6) * speed, math.sin(angle) * outward),
			spin = Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(-8, 8), rng:NextNumber(-8, 8), rng:NextNumber(-8, 8)),
			born = os.clock(),
			life = rng:NextNumber(0.7, 1.1),
		})
	end
end

-- A flat mark on the floor that stays until SPLAT_MAX newer ones push it out.
function Effects.splat(x: number, z: number, size: number, color: Color3)
	local part = take(Enum.PartType.Block, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, color)
	part.Size = Vector3.new(size, 0.05, size * rng:NextNumber(0.7, 1.1))
	part.CFrame = CFrame.new(x, 0.07 + #splats % 7 * 0.004, z) * CFrame.Angles(0, rng:NextNumber(0, math.pi), 0)
	table.insert(splats, part)
	while #splats > Config.SPLAT_MAX do
		local oldest = table.remove(splats, 1) :: Part
		fade(oldest, 1.5, nil, nil)
	end
end

function Effects.tracer(from: Vector3, to: Vector3, color: Color3)
	local length = (to - from).Magnitude
	if length < 0.05 then
		return
	end
	local part = take(Enum.PartType.Block, Enum.Material.Neon, color)
	part.Size = Vector3.new(Config.TRACER_WIDTH, Config.TRACER_WIDTH, length)
	part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((from + to) / 2, to)
	fade(part, Config.TRACER_LIFETIME, nil, nil)
end

-- Railgun: a thick glowing line that lingers a moment.
function Effects.beam(from: Vector3, to: Vector3, color: Color3)
	local length = (to - from).Magnitude
	if length < 0.05 then
		return
	end
	local mid = (from + to) / 2
	local core = take(Enum.PartType.Block, Enum.Material.Neon, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
	core.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, length)
	core.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(mid, to)
	fade(core, Config.BEAM_LIFETIME * 0.6, nil, nil)
	local glow = take(Enum.PartType.Block, Enum.Material.Neon, color)
	glow.Transparency = 0.35
	glow.Size = Vector3.new(0.9, 0.9, length)
	glow.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(mid, to)
	fade(glow, Config.BEAM_LIFETIME, glow.Size, Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, length))
end

function Effects.muzzleFlash(at: Vector3)
	local part = take(Enum.PartType.Block, Enum.Material.Neon, YELLOW_WHITE)
	part.Size = Vector3.new(0.7, 0.7, 0.7)
	part.CFrame = CFrame.new(at) * CFrame.Angles(0, rng:NextNumber(0, 1.5), 0)
	fade(part, Config.MUZZLE_FLASH_TIME, nil, nil)
end

local function shakeFrom(x: number, z: number, strength: number)
	local root = Players.LocalPlayer.Character and Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local listener = if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then root.Position else workspace.CurrentCamera.Focus.Position
	local dist = (Vector3.new(x, 0, z) - Vector3.new(listener.X, 0, listener.Z)).Magnitude
	local closeness = math.clamp(1 - dist / Config.CAMERA_SHAKE_RANGE, 0, 1)
	CameraController.shake(closeness * strength)
end

-- Round orange-and-white cartoon blast with flying blocks and a scorch mark.
function Effects.explosion(x: number, z: number, radius: number)
	local at = CFrame.new(x, 2, z)
	local outer = take(Enum.PartType.Ball, Enum.Material.Neon, ORANGE)
	outer.Transparency = 0.1
	outer.Size = Vector3.one * 2
	outer.CFrame = at
	fade(outer, 0.4, outer.Size, Vector3.one * radius * 2)
	local core = take(Enum.PartType.Ball, Enum.Material.Neon, YELLOW_WHITE)
	core.Size = Vector3.one
	core.CFrame = at
	fade(core, 0.22, core.Size, Vector3.one * radius * 1.1)
	debris(Vector3.new(x, 1, z), { ORANGE, Color3.fromRGB(60, 56, 52), YELLOW_WHITE }, 10, 26, 0.7)
	Effects.splat(x, z, radius * 0.7, Color3.fromRGB(34, 30, 28))
	shakeFrom(x, z, math.clamp(radius / 12, 0.3, 1))
	Sounds.play("explosion")
end

function Effects.enemyDeath(x: number, z: number, colors: { Color3 })
	debris(Vector3.new(x, 2, z), colors, Config.DEBRIS_PER_DEATH, 18, 0.55)
	Effects.splat(x, z, rng:NextNumber(2.4, 3.6), BLOOD:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(110, 8, 8), rng:NextNumber(0, 1)))
	Sounds.play("enemyDeath", 0.7)
end

function Effects.playerDeath(x: number, z: number)
	debris(Vector3.new(x, 2.5, z), { Config.SKIN_COLOR, Config.HAIR_COLOR, BLOOD, Config.HEADBAND_COLOR }, 12, 20, 0.6)
	Effects.splat(x, z, 4.5, BLOOD)
	Sounds.play("playerDeath")
end

-- Something placeable breaking.
function Effects.breakPuff(x: number, z: number)
	debris(Vector3.new(x, 1.5, z), { Color3.fromRGB(150, 146, 140), Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 96) }, 8, 16, 0.6)
end

function Effects.teleportPuff(x: number, z: number)
	for _ = 1, 5 do
		local part = take(Enum.PartType.Block, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Color3.fromRGB(90, 40, 120))
		part.Transparency = 0.3
		part.Size = Vector3.one * 1.2
		part.CFrame = CFrame.new(x + rng:NextNumber(-1.2, 1.2), rng:NextNumber(1, 4), z + rng:NextNumber(-1.2, 1.2))
		fade(part, 0.5, part.Size, Vector3.one * 2.4)
	end
end

function Effects.smoke(at: Vector3)
	local part = take(Enum.PartType.Block, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170))
	part.Transparency = 0.35
	part.Size = Vector3.one * 0.5
	part.CFrame = CFrame.new(at) * CFrame.Angles(rng:NextNumber(0, 1), rng:NextNumber(0, 1), 0)
	fade(part, 0.6, part.Size, Vector3.one * 1.6)
end

-- Server explosion messages: a blast, or radius 0 for a death or a break.
function Effects.fromServer(x: number, z: number, radius: number, cause: string)
	if cause == "death" then
		Effects.playerDeath(x, z)
	elseif cause == "break" then
		Effects.breakPuff(x, z)
	else
		Effects.explosion(x, z, radius)
	end
end

local function update(dt: number)
	local now = os.clock()
	for i = #fading, 1, -1 do
		local entry = fading[i]
		local t = (now - entry.born) / entry.life
		if t >= 1 then
			release(entry.part)
			fading[i] = fading[#fading]
			fading[#fading] = nil
		else
			entry.part.Transparency = entry.startTransparency + (1 - entry.startTransparency) * t
			local fromSize, toSize, center = entry.fromSize, entry.toSize, entry.center
			if fromSize and toSize and center then
				entry.part.Size = fromSize:Lerp(toSize, math.sqrt(t))
				entry.part.CFrame = center
			end
		end
	end
	for i = #chunks, 1, -1 do
		local chunk = chunks[i]
		local age = now - chunk.born
		if age >= chunk.life then
			release(chunk.part)
			chunks[i] = chunks[#chunks]
			chunks[#chunks] = nil
			continue
		end
		local velocity = chunk.velocity - Vector3.new(0, GRAVITY * dt, 0)
		local cframe = chunk.part.CFrame + velocity * dt
		local floor = chunk.part.Size.Y / 2
		if cframe.Position.Y < floor then
			cframe = CFrame.new(cframe.Position.X, floor, cframe.Position.Z) * cframe.Rotation
			velocity = Vector3.new(velocity.X * 0.6, math.abs(velocity.Y) * 0.3, velocity.Z * 0.6)
			chunk.spin *= 0.5
		end
		chunk.velocity = velocity
		chunk.part.CFrame = cframe * CFrame.Angles(chunk.spin.X * dt, chunk.spin.Y * dt, chunk.spin.Z * dt)
		if age > chunk.life - 0.3 then
			chunk.part.Transparency = (age - (chunk.life - 0.3)) / 0.3
		end
	end
end

-- Removes every splat (e.g. when a new run starts).
function Effects.clearSplats()
	for _, part in splats do
		release(part)
	end
	table.clear(splats)
end

function Effects.start()
	folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "ClientEffects"
	folder.Parent = workspace
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(update)
end

return Effects

scripts.name: EnemyRenderer
scripts.source:
--!strict
-- Draws every enemy from the server's position updates. Models come from a
-- pool per enemy type and are all moved with one BulkMoveTo call per frame.
-- Positions are drawn slightly in the past (ENEMY_INTERP_DELAY) so the
-- renderer can blend smoothly between updates. Legs swing while walking,
-- enemies flash white when hit and burst into blocks and a splat on death.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local Config = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Config"))
local EnemyModels = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Models"):WaitForChild("EnemyModels"))
local Net = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Net"))
local Snapshot = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Snapshot"))
local Effects = require(script.Parent.Effects)
local Sounds = require(script.Parent.Sounds)

type PartInfo = {
	part: Part,
	color: Color3,
	rest: CFrame, -- relative to the feet when not animated
	limb: string?,
	joint: CFrame?, -- pivot for limbs
	fromJoint: CFrame?, -- part relative to its pivot
}

type Model = { kind: string, parts: { PartInfo } }

type Sample = { t: number, x: number, z: number, facing: number }

type Rendered = {
	id: number,
	kind: string,
	model: Model,
	samples: { Sample },
	health: number,
	lastSeen: number,
	flashUntil: number,
	flashing: boolean,
	x: number,
	z: number,
	facing: number,
	phase: number,
}

export type Target = { x: number, z: number, radius: number }

local EnemyRenderer = {}

local HIDDEN = CFrame.new(0, -500, 0)
local STALE_AFTER = 1.5 -- seconds without an update before an enemy is dropped
local FLASH_COLOR = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

local folder: Folder
local pools: { [string]: { Model } } = {}
local rendered: { [number]: Rendered } = {}
local bulkParts: { BasePart } = {}
local bulkFrames: { CFrame } = {}
local groanTimer = 3

local function buildModel(kind: string): Model
	local spec = EnemyModels.SPECS[kind] or EnemyModels.SPECS.Zombie
	local scale = spec.scale
	local parts: { PartInfo } = {}
	for _, partSpec in spec.parts do
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Anchored = true
		part.CanCollide = false
		part.CanQuery = false
		part.CanTouch = false
		part.CastShadow = false
		part.Size = partSpec.size * scale
		part.Color = partSpec.color
		part.Material = if partSpec.neon then Enum.Material.Neon else Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		part.CFrame = HIDDEN
		part.Parent = folder
		local rest = CFrame.new(partSpec.offset * scale) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(partSpec.tilt or 0), 0, 0)
		local info: PartInfo = { part = part, color = partSpec.color, rest = rest, limb = partSpec.limb }
		local joint = partSpec.joint
		if joint then
			local jointFrame = CFrame.new(joint * scale)
			info.joint = jointFrame
			info.fromJoint = jointFrame:Inverse() * rest
		end
		table.insert(parts, info)
	end
	return { kind = kind, parts = parts }
end

local function acquire(kind: string): Model
	local pool = pools[kind]
	local model = pool and table.remove(pool)
	return model or buildModel(kind)
end

local function setColor(model: Model, flash: boolean)
	for _, info in model.parts do
		info.part.Color = if flash then FLASH_COLOR else info.color
	end
end

local function release(entry: Rendered)
	rendered[entry.id] = nil
	if entry.flashing then
		setColor(entry.model, false)
	end
	local parts, frames = {}, {}
	for _, info in entry.model.parts do
		table.insert(parts, info.part)
		table.insert(frames, HIDDEN)
	end
	workspace:BulkMoveTo(parts, frames, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
	local pool = pools[entry.kind]
	if not pool then
		pool = {}
		pools[entry.kind] = pool
	end
	table.insert(pool, entry.model)
end

local function onSnapshot(buf: buffer)
	local now = os.clock()
	local time = Snapshot.time(buf)
	Snapshot.read(buf, function(id: number, kindIndex: number, x: number, z: number, facing: number, health: number)
		local kind = Config.ENEMY_KINDS[kindIndex] or "Zombie"
		local entry: Rendered? = rendered[id]
		if entry and entry.kind ~= kind then
			release(entry) -- id was reused by a new enemy
			entry = nil
		end
		if not entry then
			local created: Rendered = {
				id = id,
				kind = kind,
				model = acquire(kind),
				samples = {},
				health = health,
				lastSeen = now,
				flashUntil = 0,
				flashing = false,
				x = x,
				z = z,
				facing = facing,
				phase = math.random() * 6,
			}
			rendered[id] = created
			entry = created
		end
		local current = entry :: Rendered
		if health < current.health - 1e-3 then
			current.flashUntil = now + Config.HIT_FLASH_TIME
		end
		current.health = health
		current.lastSeen = now
		table.insert(current.samples, { t = time, x = x, z = z, facing = facing })
		if #current.samples > 4 then
			table.remove(current.samples, 1)
		end
	end)
end

local function onDied(list: { number })
	for i = 1, #list - 3, 4 do
		local id, kindIndex, x, z = list[i], list[i + 1], list[i + 2], list[i + 3]
		local entry = rendered[id]
		if entry then
			release(entry)
		end
		local spec = EnemyModels.SPECS[Config.ENEMY_KINDS[kindIndex] or "Zombie"] or EnemyModels.SPECS.Zombie
		Effects.enemyDeath(x, z, spec.debris)
	end
end

local function onEvent(kind: string, id: number?, x0: number?, z0: number?, x1: number?, z1: number?)
	if kind == "clear" then
		for _, entry in rendered do
			release(entry)
		end
		Effects.clearSplats()
	elseif kind == "teleport" and id and x0 and z0 and x1 and z1 then
		Effects.teleportPuff(x0, z0)
		Effects.teleportPuff(x1, z1)
		local entry = rendered[id]
		if entry then
			-- Jump straight there instead of sliding.
			entry.samples = { { t = workspace:GetServerTimeNow(), x = x1, z = z1, facing = entry.facing } }
			entry.x, entry.z = x1, z1
		end
	end
end

local function lerpAngle(a: number, b: number, t: number): number
	local diff = (b - a + math.pi) % (math.pi * 2) - math.pi
	return a + diff * t
end

-- Where an enemy should be drawn at `time`, blending between samples.
local function sample(entry: Rendered, time: number): (number, number, number)
	local samples = entry.samples
	local count = #samples
	if count == 0 then
		return entry.x, entry.z, entry.facing
	end
	if time <= samples[1].t then
		return samples[1].x, samples[1].z, samples[1].facing
	end
	for i = 1, count - 1 do
		local a, b = samples[i], samples[i + 1]
		if time <= b.t then
			local span = b.t - a.t
			local t = if span > 1e-4 then (time - a.t) / span else 1
			return a.x + (b.x - a.x) * t, a.z + (b.z - a.z) * t, lerpAngle(a.facing, b.facing, t)
		end
	end
	local last = samples[count]
	return last.x, last.z, last.facing
end

local function update(dt: number)
	local now = os.clock()
	local renderTime = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - Config.ENEMY_INTERP_DELAY
	table.clear(bulkParts)
	table.clear(bulkFrames)
	local count = 0
	for _, entry in rendered do
		if now - entry.lastSeen > STALE_AFTER then
			release(entry)
			continue
		end
		count += 1
		local x, z, facing = sample(entry, renderTime)
		local moved = math.sqrt((x - entry.x) ^ 2 + (z - entry.z) ^ 2)
		local speed = if dt > 0 then moved / dt else 0
		entry.x, entry.z, entry.facing = x, z, facing
		entry.phase += speed * dt * 0.55
		local swing = math.sin(entry.phase) * math.min(speed / 6, 1) * 0.7

		local flash = now < entry.flashUntil
		if flash ~= entry.flashing then
			entry.flashing = flash
			setColor(entry.model, flash)
		end

		local base = CFrame.new(x, 0, z) * CFrame.Angles(0, facing, 0)
		for _, info in entry.model.parts do
			local limb, joint, fromJoint = info.limb, info.joint, info.fromJoint
			local frame
			if limb and joint and fromJoint then
				local angle = 0
				if limb == "Leg" then
					angle = swing
				elseif limb == "LegOpposite" then
					angle = -swing
				elseif limb == "Arm" then
					angle = -swing * 0.8
				elseif limb == "ArmOpposite" then
					angle = swing * 0.8
				else -- "Bob": zombie arms sway a little
					angle = math.sin(entry.phase * 2) * 0.08
				end
				frame = base * joint * CFrame.Angles(angle, 0, 0) * fromJoint
			else
				frame = base * info.rest
			end
			table.insert(bulkParts, info.part)
			table.insert(bulkFrames, frame)
		end
	end
	if #bulkParts > 0 then
		workspace:BulkMoveTo(bulkParts, bulkFrames, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
	end

	groanTimer -= dt
	if groanTimer <= 0 then
		groanTimer = math.random(3, 7)
		if count > 0 then
			Sounds.play("zombieGroan", 0.6)
		end
	end
end

-- Where this client currently draws each enemy, for instant tracer endpoints.
function EnemyRenderer.targets(): { Target }
	local list: { Target } = {}
	for _, entry in rendered do
		local def = Config.ENEMIES[entry.kind]
		table.insert(list, { x = entry.x, z = entry.z, radius = if def then def.radius else 1 })
	end
	return list
end

function EnemyRenderer.start()
	folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "Enemies"
	folder.Parent = workspace
	Net.unreliable("EnemySnapshot").OnClientEvent:Connect(onSnapshot)
	Net.event("EnemyDied").OnClientEvent:Connect(onDied)
	Net.event("EnemyEvent").OnClientEvent:Connect(onEvent)
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(update)
end

return EnemyRenderer

--!strict
-- The results screen when a run ends: wave reached, room and difficulty,
-- and every player's score and kills, with a countdown back to the lobby.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local Net = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Net"))
local Rooms = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Rooms"))
local UI = require(script.Parent.UI)

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local GameOverUI = {}

local function formatNumber(n: number): string
	local text = tostring(math.floor(n))
	local formatted = text:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)", "%1,"):reverse()
	return (formatted:gsub("^,", ""))
end

function GameOverUI.start()
	local gui = UI.screen("GameOver", 12)
	local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
	panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	panel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(480, 300)
	panel.BackgroundColor3 = UI.PANEL
	panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
	panel.Visible = false
	UI.round(panel, 14)
	panel.Parent = gui

	local title = UI.text(panel, "GAME OVER", 56)
	title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 10)
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 60)
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 50, 40)
	local subtitle = UI.text(panel, "", 20)
	subtitle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 70)
	subtitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
	local rows = Instance.new("Frame")
	rows.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	rows.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 104)
	rows.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 1, -150)
	rows.Parent = panel
	local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
	layout.Parent = rows
	local footer = UI.text(panel, "", 18)
	footer.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
	footer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -10)
	footer.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)

	local token = 0
	Net.event("RunResults").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(summary: any)
		token += 1
		local mine = token
		for _, child in rows:GetChildren() do
			if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
		local room = Rooms.ARENAS[summary.room]
		subtitle.Text = "WAVE " .. tostring(summary.wave) .. "  -  " .. (if room then room.name else "") .. "  -  " .. string.upper(tostring(summary.difficulty))
		for rank, result in summary.players do
			local line = UI.text(rows, string.format("%d.  %s     %s pts     %d kills", rank, result.name, formatNumber(result.score), result.kills), 20)
			line.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28)
			line.LayoutOrder = rank
			if result.userId == player.UserId then
				line.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 60)
			end
		end
		panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(480, 160 + #summary.players * 32)
		panel.Visible = true
		local seconds = tonumber(summary.returnIn) or 10
		task.spawn(function()
			for left = seconds, 1, -1 do
				if token ~= mine then
					return
				end
				footer.Text = "Back to the lobby in " .. left
				task.wait(1)
			end
			if token == mine then
				panel.Visible = false
			end
		end)
	end)
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("InRun"):Connect(function()
		if player:GetAttribute("InRun") == true then
			panel.Visible = false
		end
	end)
end

return GameOverUI

--!strict
-- The in-run HUD: health and score (top left), the big multiplier with its
-- draining bar (top center), wave and room (top right), teammates (right),
-- weapon slots 1-0 with ammo (bottom center), a red flash when you are hurt
-- and a SPECTATING label when you are down. Hidden in the lobby.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local Combo = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Combo"))
local Config = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Config"))
local Net = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Net"))
local Rooms = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Rooms"))
local CameraController = require(script.Parent.CameraController)
local Input = require(script.Parent.InputController)
local UI = require(script.Parent.UI)
local WeaponController = require(script.Parent.WeaponController)

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local HUD = {}

type Slot = { frame: Frame, stroke: UIStroke, key: TextLabel, name: TextLabel, ammo: TextLabel }
type MateRow = { frame: Frame, name: TextLabel, fill: Frame, mult: TextLabel }

local MULT_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 60)
local HEALTH_GOOD = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 90)
local HEALTH_LOW = Color3.fromRGB(230, 50, 40)

local function formatNumber(n: number): string
	local text = tostring(math.floor(n))
	local formatted = text:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)", "%1,"):reverse()
	return (formatted:gsub("^,", ""))
end

local function bar(parent: Instance, size: UDim2, color: Color3): (Frame, Frame)
	local back = Instance.new("Frame")
	back.Size = size
	back.BackgroundColor3 = UI.DARK
	back.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
	back.BorderSizePixel = 0
	UI.round(back, 6)
	back.Parent = parent
	local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	fill.BackgroundColor3 = color
	fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	UI.round(fill, 6)
	fill.Parent = back
	return back, fill
end

function HUD.start()
	local gui = UI.screen("HUD", 1)

	-- Health and score
	local healthBack, healthFill = bar(gui, UDim2.fromOffset(240, 22), HEALTH_GOOD)
	healthBack.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 12)
	local healthText = UI.text(healthBack, "100", 16)
	healthText.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	healthText.ZIndex = 2
	local scoreLabel = UI.text(gui, "SCORE 0", 26)
	scoreLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 38)
	scoreLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 32)
	scoreLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

	-- Multiplier
	local multLabel = UI.text(gui, "x1", 64)
	multLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	multLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0)
	multLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 68)
	multLabel.TextColor3 = MULT_COLOR
	local multScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	multScale.Parent = multLabel
	local multBack, multFill = bar(gui, UDim2.fromOffset(180, 10), MULT_COLOR)
	multBack.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	multBack.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 68)

	-- Wave and room
	local waveLabel = UI.text(gui, "WAVE 1", 30)
	waveLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	waveLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 52)
	waveLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(260, 34)
	waveLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	local roomLabel = UI.text(gui, "", 16)
	roomLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	roomLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 84)
	roomLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(260, 20)
	roomLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right

	-- Teammates
	local mates = Instance.new("Frame")
	mates.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	mates.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	mates.Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 112)
	mates.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(210, 300)
	mates.Parent = gui
	local mateList = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	mateList.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
	mateList.Parent = mates
	local mateRows: { [Player]: MateRow } = {}

	-- Weapon bar
	local slotsFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
	slotsFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	slotsFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
	slotsFrame.Parent = gui
	local slotLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	slotLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
	slotLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
	slotLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
	slotLayout.Parent = slotsFrame
	local slots: { [string]: Slot } = {}
	for order, id in Config.WEAPON_ORDER do
		local def = Config.WEAPONS[id]
		local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
		frame.LayoutOrder = order
		frame.BackgroundColor3 = UI.PANEL
		frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
		UI.round(frame, 8)
		local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		stroke.Thickness = 2
		stroke.Color = UI.DARK
		stroke.Parent = frame
		local key = UI.text(frame, tostring(def.slot % 10), 14)
		key.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 2)
		key.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14)
		key.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		local name = UI.text(frame, def.short, 13)
		name.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.2)
		name.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.45)
		name.TextScaled = true
		local nameLimit = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
		nameLimit.MaxTextSize = 14
		nameLimit.Parent = name
		local ammoLabel = UI.text(frame, "", 14)
		ammoLabel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.62)
		ammoLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.34)
		frame.Parent = slotsFrame
		slots[id] = { frame = frame, stroke = stroke, key = key, name = name, ammo = ammoLabel }
	end

	local function layoutSlots()
		local touch = Input.scheme == "Touch"
		local size = if touch then 46 else 60
		for _, slot in slots do
			slot.frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
		end
		slotsFrame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(#Config.WEAPON_ORDER * (size + 6), size)
		if touch then
			slotsFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
			slotsFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 86)
		else
			slotsFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
			slotsFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -14)
		end
	end
	layoutSlots()
	Input.SchemeChanged:Connect(layoutSlots)

	local function refreshSlots()
		local equipped = WeaponController.getEquipped()
		for id, slot in slots do
			local owns = WeaponController.owns(id)
			slot.frame.BackgroundTransparency = if owns then 0.15 else 0.6
			slot.name.TextTransparency = if owns then 0 else 0.7
			slot.name.Text = if owns then Config.WEAPONS[id].short else "?"
			slot.stroke.Color = if id == equipped then MULT_COLOR else UI.DARK
			slot.stroke.Thickness = if id == equipped then 3 else 2
			local left = WeaponController.getAmmo(id)
			slot.ammo.Text = if not owns then "" elseif left == nil then "inf" else tostring(left)
			slot.ammo.TextColor3 = if left == 0 then HEALTH_LOW else UI.WHITE
		end
	end
	WeaponController.Changed:Connect(refreshSlots)
	refreshSlots()

	-- Hurt flash
	local hurt = Instance.new("Frame")
	hurt.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	hurt.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 0, 0)
	hurt.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	hurt.ZIndex = 0
	hurt.Parent = gui
	local hurtLevel = 0
	Net.event("PlayerHurt").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(amount: number)
		hurtLevel = math.min(0.55, hurtLevel + 0.15 + amount / 100)
	end)

	-- Spectating
	local spectateLabel = UI.text(gui, "", 24)
	spectateLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
	spectateLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -96)
	spectateLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(500, 30)

	local lastMult = 1
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt: number)
		local inRun = player:GetAttribute("InRun") == true
		gui.Enabled = inRun
		if not inRun then
			return
		end

		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local health = if humanoid then math.max(0, humanoid.Health) else 0
		local maxHealth = if humanoid then humanoid.MaxHealth else Config.PLAYER_MAX_HEALTH
		local fraction = math.clamp(health / maxHealth, 0, 1)
		healthFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(fraction, 1)
		healthFill.BackgroundColor3 = HEALTH_LOW:Lerp(HEALTH_GOOD, fraction)
		healthText.Text = tostring(math.ceil(health))
		local score = player:GetAttribute("Score")
		scoreLabel.Text = "SCORE " .. formatNumber(if typeof(score) == "number" then score else 0)

		-- Work out the multiplier from (base, drain start), like the server does.
		local base, graceEnd = player:GetAttribute("Mult"), player:GetAttribute("MultGraceEnd")
		local now = if workspace:GetAttribute("Paused") == true then -math.huge else workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
		local value, barFill = 1, 0
		if typeof(base) == "number" and typeof(graceEnd) == "number" then
			if now == -math.huge then
				value, barFill = base, 1
			else
				value = Combo.valueAt(base, graceEnd, now)
				barFill = if now < graceEnd then (graceEnd - now) / Config.MULT_DECAY_DELAY else value - math.floor(value)
			end
		end
		local whole = math.floor(value)
		multLabel.Text = "x" .. whole
		if whole > lastMult then
			multScale.Scale = 1.35
		end
		lastMult = whole
		multScale.Scale += (1 - multScale.Scale) * math.min(1, dt * 10)
		multFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(barFill, 0, 1), 1)

		local wave = ReplicatedStorage:GetAttribute("Wave")
		waveLabel.Text = if typeof(wave) == "number" and wave > 0 then "WAVE " .. wave else "GET READY"
		local roomId, difficulty = ReplicatedStorage:GetAttribute("RoomId"), ReplicatedStorage:GetAttribute("Difficulty")
		local room = if typeof(roomId) == "string" then Rooms.ARENAS[roomId] else nil
		roomLabel.Text = (if room then room.name else "") .. (if typeof(difficulty) == "string" then "  -  " .. string.upper(difficulty) else "")

		-- Teammates
		local seen: { [Player]: boolean } = {}
		for _, other in Players:GetPlayers() do
			if other == player or other:GetAttribute("InRun") ~= true then
				continue
			end
			seen[other] = true
			local row = mateRows[other]
			if not row then
				local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
				frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(210, 40)
				frame.BackgroundColor3 = UI.PANEL
				frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
				UI.round(frame, 8)
				local name = UI.text(frame, other.DisplayName, 16)
				name.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 2)
				name.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(140, 20)
				name.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
				local back, fill = bar(frame, UDim2.fromOffset(140, 8), HEALTH_GOOD)
				back.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 25)
				local mult = UI.text(frame, "x1", 22)
				mult.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
				mult.Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0)
				mult.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 30)
				mult.TextColor3 = MULT_COLOR
				mult.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
				frame.Parent = mates
				row = { frame = frame, name = name, fill = fill, mult = mult }
				mateRows[other] = row
			end
			local current = row :: MateRow
			local otherCharacter = other.Character
			local otherHumanoid = otherCharacter and otherCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local otherFraction = if otherHumanoid then math.clamp(otherHumanoid.Health / otherHumanoid.MaxHealth, 0, 1) else 0
			current.fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(otherFraction, 1)
			current.fill.BackgroundColor3 = HEALTH_LOW:Lerp(HEALTH_GOOD, otherFraction)
			local hero = otherCharacter and otherCharacter:FindFirstChild("Hero")
			local torso = hero and hero:FindFirstChild("Torso")
			if torso and torso:IsA("BasePart") then
				current.name.TextColor3 = torso.Color:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.35)
			end
			local otherBase, otherGrace = other:GetAttribute("Mult"), other:GetAttribute("MultGraceEnd")
			if typeof(otherBase) == "number" and typeof(otherGrace) == "number" and now ~= -math.huge then
				current.mult.Text = "x" .. math.floor(Combo.valueAt(otherBase, otherGrace, now))
			end
		end
		for other, row in mateRows do
			if not seen[other] then
				row.frame:Destroy()
				mateRows[other] = nil
			end
		end

		hurtLevel = math.max(0, hurtLevel - dt * 1.5)
		hurt.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - hurtLevel

		local watching = CameraController.spectating()
		spectateLabel.Text = if watching then "SPECTATING " .. string.upper(watching.DisplayName) .. "   (Q / E to switch)" else ""
	end)
end

return HUD

--!strict
-- Keeps the health bar over every player's head up to date. Your own name is
-- hidden (you know who you are) but your bar stays.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local HealthBars = {}

local GOOD = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 90)
local LOW = Color3.fromRGB(230, 50, 40)

local timer = 0

local function update(dt: number)
	timer -= dt
	if timer > 0 then
		return
	end
	timer = 0.1
	for _, other in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local character = other.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local hero = character and character:FindFirstChild("Hero")
		local head = hero and hero:FindFirstChild("Head")
		local tag = head and head:FindFirstChild("NameTag")
		if not humanoid or not tag then
			continue
		end
		local name = tag:FindFirstChild("PlayerName")
		if name and name:IsA("TextLabel") then
			name.Visible = other ~= Players.LocalPlayer
		end
		local bar = tag:FindFirstChild("Bar")
		local fill = bar and bar:FindFirstChild("Fill")
		if fill and fill:IsA("Frame") then
			local fraction = math.clamp(humanoid.Health / math.max(humanoid.MaxHealth, 1), 0, 1)
			fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(fraction, 1)
			fill.BackgroundColor3 = LOW:Lerp(GOOD, fraction)
		end
	end
end

function HealthBars.start()
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(update)
end

return HealthBars

--!strict
-- Turns keyboard, mouse and touch input into game intents: a move vector,
-- whether fire is held, weapon picks and pause.
--
-- Schemes:
--   Classic (default): WASD/arrows move in 8 directions and set facing, Space fires.
--   Mouse: WASD/arrows move, the mouse aims, click (or Space) fires.
--   Touch: on-screen thumbstick and buttons (see MobileControls).

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local Signal = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Signal"))

export type Scheme = "Classic" | "Mouse" | "Touch"

local Input = {}

Input.scheme = "Classic" :: Scheme
Input.SchemeChanged = Signal.new() -- (scheme: Scheme)
Input.WeaponSlot = Signal.new() -- (slot: number), 10 is the 0 key
Input.CycleWeapon = Signal.new() -- (step: number), -1 or 1
Input.PausePressed = Signal.new()

local NORTH = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
local SOUTH = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
local WEST = Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0)
local EAST = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)

local MOVE_KEYS: { [Enum.KeyCode]: Vector3 } = {
	[Enum.KeyCode.W] = NORTH,
	[Enum.KeyCode.Up] = NORTH,
	[Enum.KeyCode.S] = SOUTH,
	[Enum.KeyCode.Down] = SOUTH,
	[Enum.KeyCode.A] = WEST,
	[Enum.KeyCode.Left] = WEST,
	[Enum.KeyCode.D] = EAST,
	[Enum.KeyCode.Right] = EAST,
}

local SLOT_KEYS: { [Enum.KeyCode]: number } = {
	[Enum.KeyCode.One] = 1,
	[Enum.KeyCode.Two] = 2,
	[Enum.KeyCode.Three] = 3,
	[Enum.KeyCode.Four] = 4,
	[Enum.KeyCode.Five] = 5,
	[Enum.KeyCode.Six] = 6,
	[Enum.KeyCode.Seven] = 7,
	[Enum.KeyCode.Eight] = 8,
	[Enum.KeyCode.Nine] = 9,
	[Enum.KeyCode.Zero] = 10,
}

local touchMove = Vector3.zero
local touchFire = false
local mouseFire = false
-- Keys pressed while the game had input focus (not typed into chat or a text box).
local held: { [Enum.KeyCode]: boolean } = {}

local function releaseAll()
	table.clear(held)
	mouseFire = false
end

-- World-space move direction on the floor plane, length 0 to 1.
function Input.getMoveVector(): Vector3
	if Input.scheme == "Touch" then
		return touchMove
	end
	local sum = Vector3.zero
	for key, dir in MOVE_KEYS do
		if held[key] then
			sum += dir
		end
	end
	-- W and Up together still count once.
	local move = Vector3.new(math.clamp(sum.X, -1, 1), 0, math.clamp(sum.Z, -1, 1))
	if move.Magnitude > 0 then
		return move.Unit
	end
	return move
end

function Input.isFireHeld(): boolean
	if Input.scheme == "Touch" then
		return touchFire
	end
	if held[Enum.KeyCode.Space] then
		return true
	end
	return Input.scheme == "Mouse" and mouseFire
end

-- The point under the mouse cursor on the horizontal plane at `height`.
function Input.getMouseGroundPoint(height: number): Vector3?
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local mouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
	local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(mouse.X, mouse.Y)
	if math.abs(ray.Direction.Y) < 1e-4 then
		return nil
	end
	local t = (height - ray.Origin.Y) / ray.Direction.Y
	if t < 0 then
		return nil
	end
	return ray.Origin + ray.Direction * t
end

function Input.setTouchMove(move: Vector3)
	touchMove = move
end

function Input.setTouchFire(held: boolean)
	touchFire = held
end

function Input.setScheme(scheme: Scheme)
	if scheme ~= Input.scheme then
		Input.scheme = scheme
		mouseFire = false
		Input.SchemeChanged:Fire(scheme)
	end
end

function Input.start()
	if UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled then
		Input.scheme = "Touch"
	end

	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject, processed: boolean)
		if processed then
			return
		end
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			mouseFire = true
			return
		end
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
			return
		end
		local key = input.KeyCode
		held[key] = true
		local slot = SLOT_KEYS[key]
		if slot then
			Input.WeaponSlot:Fire(slot)
		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.Q then
			Input.CycleWeapon:Fire(-1)
		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.E then
			Input.CycleWeapon:Fire(1)
		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.P then
			Input.PausePressed:Fire()
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			mouseFire = false
		elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
			held[input.KeyCode] = nil
		end
	end)

	-- Never leave a key stuck down when focus moves to chat or another window.
	UserInputService.TextBoxFocused:Connect(releaseAll)
	UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(releaseAll)
end

return Input

--!strict
-- On-screen controls for phones and tablets: a thumbstick on the left half of
-- the screen to move and face, plus FIRE and SWAP (next weapon) buttons.

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local Input = require(script.Parent.InputController)
local UI = require(script.Parent.UI)

local MobileControls = {}

local STICK_RADIUS = 60
local DEADZONE = 0.15

function MobileControls.start()
	local gui = UI.screen("MobileControls", 5)

	-- Thumbstick: appears where the thumb lands anywhere on the left half.
	local zone = Instance.new("Frame")
	zone.Name = "MoveZone"
	zone.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	zone.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1)
	zone.Parent = gui

	local base = Instance.new("Frame")
	base.Name = "Stick"
	base.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	base.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(STICK_RADIUS * 2, STICK_RADIUS * 2)
	base.BackgroundColor3 = UI.DARK
	base.BackgroundTransparency = 0.55
	UI.round(base, STICK_RADIUS)
	base.Parent = zone
	local restPosition = UDim2.new(0, 120, 1, -120)
	base.Position = restPosition

	local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
	knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	knob.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 56)
	knob.BackgroundColor3 = UI.WHITE
	knob.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
	UI.round(knob, 28)
	knob.Parent = base

	local moveTouch: InputObject? = nil
	local startPos = Vector2.zero

	local function releaseStick()
		moveTouch = nil
		Input.setTouchMove(Vector3.zero)
		base.Position = restPosition
		knob.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	end

	zone.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
		if moveTouch or input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			return
		end
		moveTouch = input
		startPos = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
		base.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(startPos.X - zone.AbsolutePosition.X, startPos.Y - zone.AbsolutePosition.Y)
	end)

	UserInputService.TouchMoved:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
		if input ~= moveTouch then
			return
		end
		local offset = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y) - startPos
		if offset.Magnitude > STICK_RADIUS then
			offset = offset.Unit * STICK_RADIUS
		end
		knob.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, offset.X, 0.5, offset.Y)
		if offset.Magnitude / STICK_RADIUS < DEADZONE then
			Input.setTouchMove(Vector3.zero)
		else
			-- Screen down is south (+Z) because the camera looks north.
			Input.setTouchMove(Vector3.new(offset.X, 0, offset.Y) / STICK_RADIUS)
		end
	end)

	-- FIRE: hold to keep shooting.
	local fireButton = UI.button(gui, "FIRE", 28)
	fireButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
	fireButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -36, 1, -36)
	fireButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(112, 112)
	fireButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(196, 58, 40)
	UI.round(fireButton, 56)

	local fireTouch: InputObject? = nil
	local function releaseFire()
		fireTouch = nil
		Input.setTouchFire(false)
	end
	fireButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			fireTouch = input
			Input.setTouchFire(true)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.TouchEnded:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
		if input == moveTouch then
			releaseStick()
		elseif input == fireTouch then
			releaseFire()
		end
	end)

	-- SWAP: next owned weapon.
	local swapButton = UI.button(gui, "SWAP", 20)
	swapButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
	swapButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -164, 1, -36)
	swapButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(76, 76)
	UI.round(swapButton, 38)
	swapButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		Input.CycleWeapon:Fire(1)
	end)

	local function refresh()
		gui.Enabled = Input.scheme == "Touch"
		if not gui.Enabled then
			releaseStick()
			releaseFire()
		end
	end
	Input.SchemeChanged:Connect(refresh)
	refresh()
end

return MobileControls

--!strict
-- The party panel in the lobby, shown while you stand on a party pad.
-- The leader picks the room, difficulty, party size and friends-only, then
-- presses START; everyone else sees the choices and waits.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local Config = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Config"))
local Net = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Net"))
local Rooms = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Rooms"))
local UI = require(script.Parent.UI)

local PartyAction = Net.event("PartyAction")

local PartyUI = {}

type Picker = { label: TextLabel, left: TextButton, right: TextButton }

local GREEN = Color3.fromRGB(60, 170, 80)
local RED = Color3.fromRGB(196, 58, 40)

function PartyUI.start()
	local gui = UI.screen("Party", 8)
	local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
	panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	panel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0.5, 0)
	panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 384)
	panel.BackgroundColor3 = UI.PANEL
	panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
	panel.Visible = false
	UI.round(panel, 14)
	panel.Parent = gui

	local function text(content: string, size: number, y: number, height: number): TextLabel
		local label = UI.text(panel, content, size)
		label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, y)
		label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, height)
		label.TextWrapped = true
		return label
	end

	local title = text("PARTY", 28, 8, 34)
	local leaderLabel = text("", 16, 42, 20)
	local membersLabel = text("", 15, 62, 40)

	local function picker(caption: string, y: number): Picker
		text(caption, 14, y, 18).TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210)
		local left = UI.button(panel, "<", 22)
		left.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, y + 20)
		left.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 34)
		local right = UI.button(panel, ">", 22)
		right.Position = UDim2.new(1, -52, 0, y + 20)
		right.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 34)
		local value = UI.text(panel, "", 22)
		value.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(56, y + 20)
		value.Size = UDim2.new(1, -112, 0, 34)
		return { label = value, left = left, right = right }
	end

	local roomPicker = picker("ROOM", 104)
	local difficultyPicker = picker("DIFFICULTY", 162)
	local sizePicker = picker("PARTY SIZE", 220)

	local friendsButton = UI.button(panel, "FRIENDS ONLY: OFF", 18)
	friendsButton.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 282)
	friendsButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 34)

	local startButton = UI.button(panel, "START", 24)
	startButton.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 324)
	startButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 44)
	startButton.BackgroundColor3 = GREEN
	local waitingLabel = text("", 18, 324, 44)

	local state: any = nil

	local function step(list: { string }, current: string, delta: number): string
		local index = table.find(list, current) or 1
		return list[(index - 1 + delta) % #list + 1]
	end

	roomPicker.left.Activated:Connect(function()
		if state then
			PartyAction:FireServer("room", step(Rooms.ORDER, state.room, -1))
		end
	end)
	roomPicker.right.Activated:Connect(function()
		if state then
			PartyAction:FireServer("room", step(Rooms.ORDER, state.room, 1))
		end
	end)
	difficultyPicker.left.Activated:Connect(function()
		if state then
			PartyAction:FireServer("difficulty", step(Config.DIFFICULTY_ORDER, state.difficulty, -1))
		end
	end)
	difficultyPicker.right.Activated:Connect(function()
		if state then
			PartyAction:FireServer("difficulty", step(Config.DIFFICULTY_ORDER, state.difficulty, 1))
		end
	end)
	sizePicker.left.Activated:Connect(function()
		if state then
			PartyAction:FireServer("size", state.size - 1)
		end
	end)
	sizePicker.right.Activated:Connect(function()
		if state then
			PartyAction:FireServer("size", state.size + 1)
		end
	end)
	friendsButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		if state then
			PartyAction:FireServer("friends", not state.friendsOnly)
		end
	end)
	startButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		if state then
			PartyAction:FireServer(if state.countdown then "cancel" else "start")
		end
	end)

	Net.event("PartyState").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(newState: any)
		state = newState
		if not newState then
			panel.Visible = false
			return
		end
		panel.Visible = true
		local leader = newState.isLeader == true
		title.Text = "PARTY " .. tostring(newState.pad)
		leaderLabel.Text = "Leader: " .. tostring(newState.leader)
		membersLabel.Text = table.concat(newState.members, ", ")
		local room = Rooms.ARENAS[newState.room]
		roomPicker.label.Text = if room then room.name else tostring(newState.room)
		difficultyPicker.label.Text = string.upper(tostring(newState.difficulty))
		sizePicker.label.Text = tostring(#newState.members) .. " / " .. tostring(newState.size)
		for _, pick in { roomPicker, difficultyPicker, sizePicker } do
			pick.left.Visible = leader
			pick.right.Visible = leader
		end
		friendsButton.Text = "FRIENDS ONLY: " .. (if newState.friendsOnly then "ON" else "OFF")
		friendsButton.BackgroundColor3 = if newState.friendsOnly then GREEN else UI.BUTTON
		friendsButton.AutoButtonColor = leader
		friendsButton.Active = leader

		local countdown = newState.countdown
		startButton.Visible = leader
		if countdown then
			startButton.Text = "CANCEL (" .. tostring(countdown) .. ")"
			startButton.BackgroundColor3 = RED
		else
			startButton.Text = "START"
			startButton.BackgroundColor3 = GREEN
		end
		waitingLabel.Visible = not leader
		waitingLabel.Text = if countdown then "STARTING IN " .. tostring(countdown) else "Waiting for the leader to start.\nStep off the pad to leave."
	end)
end

return PartyUI

--!strict
-- Sends P presses to the server and shows a PAUSED overlay while paused.
-- Pausing only works with one player on the server.

	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true

	local shade = Instance.new("Frame")

	shade.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	shade.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
	shade.Visible = false
	shade.Parent = gui

	local title = UI.text(shade, "PAUSED", 80)
	title.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	title.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.45)
	title.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(600, 90)

	local hint = UI.text(shade, "Press P to resume", 24)
	hint.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	hint.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.45, 56)
	hint.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(600, 30)

	soloNote.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	soloNote.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.2)
	soloNote.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(600, 30)

		shade.Visible = workspace:GetAttribute("Paused") == true
	end
	workspace:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Paused"):Connect(refresh)
	refresh()

	local PauseRequest = Net.event("PauseRequest")
	local noteToken = 0
	Input.PausePressed:Connect(function()
		if #Players:GetPlayers() == 1 then
			PauseRequest:FireServer()
			return
		end
		noteToken += 1
		local token = noteToken
		soloNote.Visible = true
		task.delay(2, function()
			if token == noteToken then
				soloNote.Visible = false
			end
		end)
	end)
end

return PauseUI

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Net = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Net"))
local Sounds = require(script.Parent.Sounds)
local UI = require(script.Parent.UI)

type Style = { y: number, size: number, color: Color3, hold: number }

local Popups = {}

local STYLES: { [string]: Style } = {
	wave = { y = 0.3, size = 72, color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 60), hold = 1.6 },
	unlock = { y = 0.42, size = 44, color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), hold = 2 },
	big = { y = 0.38, size = 80, color = Color3.fromRGB(230, 50, 40), hold = 2.5 },
	info = { y = 0.22, size = 26, color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), hold = 2.4 },
	pickup = { y = 0.62, size = 30, color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 230, 110), hold = 0.8 },
}

local labels: { [string]: TextLabel } = {}
local tokens: { [string]: number } = {}
local unlockQueue: { string } = {}
local unlockBusy = false

local function show(style: string, text: string)
	local spec = STYLES[style] or STYLES.info
	local label = labels[style]
	if not label then
		return
	end
	tokens[style] = (tokens[style] or 0) + 1
	local token = tokens[style]
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = spec.color
	label.TextTransparency = 0
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	label.Visible = true
	local scale = label:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale") :: UIScale
	scale.Scale = 0.4
	TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
	task.delay(spec.hold, function()
		if tokens[style] ~= token then
			return
		end
		local fade = TweenInfo.new(0.4)
		TweenService:Create(label, fade, { TextTransparency = 1, TextStrokeTransparency = 1 }):Play()
	end)
end

local function pumpUnlocks()
	if unlockBusy then
		return
	end
	local text = table.remove(unlockQueue, 1)
	if not text then
		return
	end
	unlockBusy = true
	show("unlock", text)
	Sounds.play("unlock")
	task.delay(1.2, function()
		unlockBusy = false
		pumpUnlocks()
	end)
end

function Popups.show(text: string, style: string)
	if style == "unlock" then
		table.insert(unlockQueue, text)
		pumpUnlocks()
	else
		show(style, text)
	end
end

function Popups.start()
	local gui = UI.screen("Popups", 15)
	for name, spec in STYLES do
		local label = UI.text(gui, "", spec.size)
		label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		label.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, spec.y)
		label.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, spec.size + 10)
		label.TextWrapped = true
		label.Visible = false
		local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
		scale.Parent = label
		labels[name] = label
	end
	Net.event("Announce").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(text: string, style: string)
		Popups.show(text, style)
	end)
end

return Popups

scripts.source:
--!strict
-- Draws grenades (arc through the air, then blink until they go off),
-- rockets (with a smoke trail) and devil fireballs from the server's
-- spawn messages. The server decides where they hit.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Net = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Net"))
local Effects = require(script.Parent.Effects)
local Sounds = require(script.Parent.Sounds)

type Flying = {
	kind: string,
	parts: { Part },
	born: number,
	x: number,
	z: number,
	dx: number,
	dz: number,
	speed: number,
	toX: number,
	toZ: number,
	flight: number,
	smokeTimer: number,
}

local ProjectileRenderer = {}

local HEIGHT = 3.5
local MAX_AGE = 12

local folder: Folder
local flying: { [number]: Flying } = {}

local function part(size: Vector3, color: Color3, neon: boolean, shape: Enum.PartType?): Part
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide = false
	p.CanQuery = false
	p.CanTouch = false
	p.CastShadow = false
	p.Size = size
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = if neon then Enum.Material.Neon else Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.Shape = shape or Enum.PartType.Block
	p.Parent = folder
	return p
end

local function onMessage(action: string, id: number, kind: string?, ...: any)
	if action == "end" then
		local entry = flying[id]
		if entry then
			flying[id] = nil
			for _, p in entry.parts do
				p:Destroy()
			end
		end
		return
	end
	if action ~= "spawn" or typeof(kind) ~= "string" then
		return
	end
	local args = { ... }
	local entry: Flying = {
		kind = kind,
		parts = {},
		born = os.clock(),
		x = args[1],
		z = args[2],
		dx = 0,
		dz = 0,
		speed = 0,
		toX = 0,
		toZ = 0,
		flight = 0,
		smokeTimer = 0,
	}
	if kind == "grenade" then
		entry.toX, entry.toZ, entry.flight = args[3], args[4], args[5]
		entry.parts = {
			part(Vector3.new(0.8, 0.8, 0.8), Color3.fromRGB(60, 80, 50), false),
			part(Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3), Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 40), true),
		}
	elseif kind == "rocket" then
		entry.dx, entry.dz, entry.speed = args[3], args[4], args[5]
		entry.parts = {
			part(Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 1.8), Color3.fromRGB(96, 104, 70), false),
			part(Vector3.new(0.4, 0.4, 0.4), Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 40), true),
		}
		Sounds.play("rocket")
	elseif kind == "fireball" then
		entry.dx, entry.dz, entry.speed = args[3], args[4], args[5]
		entry.parts = {
			part(Vector3.one * 1.6, Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 20), true, Enum.PartType.Ball),
			part(Vector3.one * 0.9, Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 120), true, Enum.PartType.Ball),
		}
		entry.parts[1].Transparency = 0.25
	else
		return
	end
	flying[id] = entry
end

local function update(dt: number)
	local now = os.clock()
	for id, entry in flying do
		local age = now - entry.born
		if age > MAX_AGE then
			flying[id] = nil
			for _, p in entry.parts do
				p:Destroy()
			end
			continue
		end
		if entry.kind == "grenade" then
			local t = math.clamp(age / math.max(entry.flight, 1e-3), 0, 1)
			local x = entry.x + (entry.toX - entry.x) * t
			local z = entry.z + (entry.toZ - entry.z) * t
			local y = 0.4 + HEIGHT * 1.4 * math.sin(math.pi * t) + (1 - t) * 3
			local spin = CFrame.Angles(age * 9, age * 5, 0)
			entry.parts[1].CFrame = CFrame.new(x, y, z) * spin
			entry.parts[2].CFrame = CFrame.new(x, y + 0.5, z)
			-- Blink faster as the fuse runs down.
			entry.parts[2].Transparency = if math.floor(age * (4 + age * 6)) % 2 == 0 then 0 else 1
		else
			local x = entry.x + entry.dx * entry.speed * age
			local z = entry.z + entry.dz * entry.speed * age
			local at = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(x, HEIGHT, z), Vector3.new(x + entry.dx, HEIGHT, z + entry.dz))
			entry.parts[1].CFrame = at
			if entry.kind == "rocket" then
				entry.parts[2].CFrame = at * CFrame.new(0, 0, 1.05)
				entry.smokeTimer -= dt
				if entry.smokeTimer <= 0 then
					entry.smokeTimer = 0.03
					Effects.smoke((at * CFrame.new(0, 0, 1.4)).Position)
				end
			else
				local pulse = 1 + math.sin(age * 30) * 0.12
				entry.parts[1].Size = Vector3.one * 1.6 * pulse
				entry.parts[2].CFrame = at
			end
		end
	end
end

function ProjectileRenderer.start()
	folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "Projectiles"
	folder.Parent = workspace
	Net.event("Projectile").OnClientEvent:Connect(onMessage)
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(update)
end

return ProjectileRenderer

--!strict
-- Plays the sounds listed in Config.SOUNDS. Sounds with no id are skipped.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Config"))

local Sounds = {}

local MIN_GAP = 0.04 -- the same sound can't restart faster than this
local templates: { [string]: Sound } = {}
local lastPlayed: { [string]: number } = {}

local function template(name: string): Sound?
	local existing = templates[name]
	if existing then
		return existing
	end
	local entry = Config.SOUNDS[name]
	if not entry or entry.id == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.Name = "BlockHorde_" .. name
	sound.SoundId = entry.id
	sound.Volume = entry.volume
	sound.Parent = SoundService
	templates[name] = sound
	return sound
end

function Sounds.play(name: string, volumeScale: number?)
	local sound = template(name)
	if not sound then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (lastPlayed[name] or 0) < MIN_GAP then
		return
	end
	lastPlayed[name] = now
	local copy = sound:Clone()
	copy.Volume = sound.Volume * (volumeScale or 1)
	copy.Parent = SoundService
	copy.Ended:Once(function()
		copy:Destroy()
	end)
	copy:Play()
	task.delay(8, function()
		if copy.Parent then
			copy:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

return Sounds

scripts.name: WeaponController
scripts.source:
--!strict
-- The local player's weapons: picks the equipped weapon, fires while the fire
-- input is held (only in a run), draws hitscan tracers instantly using the
-- same pellet pattern the server will use, and asks the server to shoot.
-- Also draws other players' and turrets' shots when the server reports them.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local Config = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Config"))
local Hitscan = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Hitscan"))
local Net = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Net"))
local Signal = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Signal"))
local WeaponStats = require(Shared:WaitForChild("WeaponStats"))
local CharacterController = require(script.Parent.CharacterController)
local ClientArena = require(script.Parent.ClientArena)
local Effects = require(script.Parent.Effects)
local EnemyRenderer = require(script.Parent.EnemyRenderer)
local Input = require(script.Parent.InputController)
local Sounds = require(script.Parent.Sounds)

local Fire = Net.event("Fire")
local ShotFired = Net.event("ShotFired")
local WeaponState = Net.event("WeaponState")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local WeaponController = {}

WeaponController.Changed = Signal.new() -- equipped weapon, owned list or ammo changed

local TURRET_TRACER = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 90)

local equipped = "pistol"
local owned: { [string]: boolean } = { pistol = true }
local upgrades: { [string]: { [string]: boolean } } = {}
local ammo: { [string]: number } = {}
local nextShotAt = 0

function WeaponController.getEquipped(): string
	return equipped
end

function WeaponController.owns(weaponId: string): boolean
	return owned[weaponId] == true
end

function WeaponController.stats(weaponId: string): WeaponStats.Stats
	return WeaponStats.get(weaponId, upgrades[weaponId])
end

-- Shots left, or nil for infinite.
function WeaponController.getAmmo(weaponId: string): number?
	if WeaponController.stats(weaponId).maxAmmo == nil then
		return nil
	end
	return ammo[weaponId] or 0
end

local function hasAmmo(weaponId: string): boolean
	local left = WeaponController.getAmmo(weaponId)
	return left == nil or left > 0
end

local function equip(weaponId: string)
	if owned[weaponId] and Config.WEAPONS[weaponId] and weaponId ~= equipped then
		equipped = weaponId
		nextShotAt = math.max(nextShotAt, os.clock() + 0.1)
		WeaponController.Changed:Fire()
	end
end

-- Owned weapons in number-key order.
local function ownedInOrder(): { string }
	local list = {}
	for _, id in Config.WEAPON_ORDER do
		if owned[id] then
			table.insert(list, id)
		end
	end
	return list
end

-- Out of ammo: drop to the best owned gun that still has some.
local function switchFromEmpty()
	local list = ownedInOrder()
	for i = #list, 1, -1 do
		local id = list[i]
		local kind = Config.WEAPONS[id].kind
		if id ~= equipped and hasAmmo(id) and kind ~= "place" then
			equip(id)
			return
		end
	end
	equip("pistol")
end

local function predictTravel(stats: WeaponStats.Stats, x: number, z: number, dx: number, dz: number): number
	local grid = ClientArena.grid()
	local wall = if grid then grid:raycast(x, z, dx, dz, stats.range) else stats.range
	local function circle(t: { x: number, z: number, radius: number }): (number, number, number)
		return t.x, t.z, t.radius
	end
	local _, enemyTravel = Hitscan.cast(x, z, dx, dz, wall, EnemyRenderer.targets(), circle, stats.pierce)
	local _, barrelTravel = Hitscan.cast(x, z, dx, dz, wall, ClientArena.barrels(), circle, stats.pierce)
	if stats.pierce > 1 then
		return wall
	end
	return math.min(enemyTravel, barrelTravel)
end

local function fire()
	local stats = WeaponController.stats(equipped)
	local root = CharacterController.getRoot()
	if not root then
		return
	end
	if not hasAmmo(equipped) then
		switchFromEmpty()
		return
	end
	if stats.maxAmmo ~= nil then
		ammo[equipped] = (ammo[equipped] or 0) - 1
		WeaponController.Changed:Fire()
	end

	local dir = CharacterController.getFacing()
	local pos = root.Position
	local y = pos.Y + Config.MUZZLE_HEIGHT
	local muzzle = Vector3.new(pos.X + dir.X * Config.MUZZLE_FORWARD, y, pos.Z + dir.Z * Config.MUZZLE_FORWARD)
	local seed = math.random(1, 1000000000)

	if stats.kind == "hitscan" then
		Effects.muzzleFlash(muzzle)
		for _, pellet in WeaponStats.pelletDirections(dir.X, dir.Z, stats, seed) do
			local dx, dz = pellet[1], pellet[2]
			local travel = predictTravel(stats, pos.X, pos.Z, dx, dz)
			if travel > Config.MUZZLE_FORWARD then
				local finish = Vector3.new(pos.X + dx * travel, y, pos.Z + dz * travel)
				if stats.beam then
					Effects.beam(muzzle, finish, stats.tracerColor)
				else
					Effects.tracer(muzzle, finish, stats.tracerColor)
				end
			end
		end
		Sounds.play(equipped)
	elseif stats.kind == "rocket" then
		Effects.muzzleFlash(muzzle)
	end
	Fire:FireServer(equipped, dir.X, dir.Z, seed)

	if not hasAmmo(equipped) then
		switchFromEmpty()
	end
end

local function update()
	if player:GetAttribute("InRun") ~= true or not Input.isFireHeld() then
		return
	end
	if workspace:GetAttribute("Paused") == true or not CharacterController.isAlive() then
		return
	end
	if ReplicatedStorage:GetAttribute("RunPhase") == "Over" then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now >= nextShotAt then
		nextShotAt = now + WeaponController.stats(equipped).fireInterval
		fire()
	end
end

local function onWeaponState(ownedList: { string }, ammoTable: { [string]: number }, upgradeLists: { [string]: { string } })
	owned = {}
	for _, id in ownedList do
		owned[id] = true
	end
	if next(owned) == nil then
		owned.pistol = true
	end
	ammo = ammoTable
	upgrades = {}
	for id, names in upgradeLists do
		local set = {}
		for _, name in names do
			set[name] = true
		end
		upgrades[id] = set
	end
	if not owned[equipped] then
		equipped = "pistol"
	end
	WeaponController.Changed:Fire()
end

local function onShotFired(shooter: Player?, weaponId: string, muzzle: Vector3, endpoints: { Vector3 }, _seed: number)
	if shooter == player then
		return -- already drawn when we fired
	end
	local color = TURRET_TRACER
	local beam = false
	if weaponId ~= "turret" then
		local stats = WeaponStats.get(weaponId, nil)
		color, beam = stats.tracerColor, stats.beam
	end
	Effects.muzzleFlash(muzzle)
	for _, point in endpoints do
		if beam then
			Effects.beam(muzzle, point, color)
		else
			Effects.tracer(muzzle, point, color)
		end
	end
	if shooter then
		Sounds.play(weaponId, 0.5)
	end
end

function WeaponController.start()
	Input.WeaponSlot:Connect(function(slot: number)
		for _, id in Config.WEAPON_ORDER do
			if Config.WEAPONS[id].slot == slot then
				equip(id)
				return
			end
		end
	end)
	Input.CycleWeapon:Connect(function(step: number)
		if not CharacterController.isAlive() then
			return -- Q/E switch who you spectate instead
		end
		local list = ownedInOrder()
		if #list == 0 then
			return
		end
		local index = table.find(list, equipped) or 1
		equip(list[(index - 1 + step) % #list + 1])
	end)
	WeaponState.OnClientEvent:Connect(onWeaponState)
	ShotFired.OnClientEvent:Connect(onShotFired)
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(update)
end

return WeaponController
